<!-- ================= REVENUE CHART ================= -->

<script>
    const revenueData = [
    <c:forEach var="row"
               items="${revenueByDate}"
               varStatus="loop">
    {
    date: "${row[0]}",
            revenue: ${row[1]}
    }<c:if test="${!loop.last}">,</c:if>
    </c:forEach>
    ];
    const revenueLabels = revenueData.map(item => item.date);
    const revenueValues = revenueData.map(item => item.revenue);
    const formatVND = (value) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN", {
    style: "currency",
            currency: "VND",
            maximumFractionDigits: 0
    }).format(value);
    };
    const revenueCanvas = document.getElementById("revenueChart");
    const revenueCtx = revenueCanvas.getContext("2d");
    if (revenueCanvas) {
    const revenueGradient = revenueCtx.createLinearGradient(
            0, 0, 0, 320
            );
    revenueGradient.addColorStop(0, "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.20)");
    revenueGradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.01)");
    new Chart(revenueCanvas, {
    type: "line",
            data: {
            labels: revenueLabels,
                    datasets: [{
                    label: "Doanh thu",
                            data: revenueValues,
                            borderColor: "#2563eb",
                            backgroundColor: revenueGradient,
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            tension: 0.35,
                            fill: true,
                            pointRadius: 3,
                            pointHoverRadius: 6,
                            pointBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
                            pointBorderColor: "#2563eb",
                            pointBorderWidth: 2
                    }]
            },
            options: {
            responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: {
                    mode: "index",
                            intersect: false
                    },
                    plugins: {
                    legend: {
                    display: false
                    },
                            tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: "#0f172a",
                                    padding: 12,
                                    cornerRadius: 8,
                                    callbacks: {
                                    label: function(context) {
                                    return "Doanh thu: "
                                            + formatVND(context.parsed.y);
                                    }
                                    }
                            }
                    },
                    scales: {
                    x: {
                    grid: {
                    display: false
                    },
                            ticks: {
                            color: "#64748b",
                                    maxRotation: 45,
                                    autoSkip: true,
                                    maxTicksLimit: 10
                            }
                    },
                            y: {
                            beginAtZero: true,
                                    border: {
                                    display: false
                                    },
                                    grid: {
                                    color: "#f1f5f9"
                                    },
                                    ticks: {
                                    color: "#64748b",
                                            callback: function(value) {
                                            return new Intl.NumberFormat(
                                                    "vi-VN", {
                                                    notation: "compact",
                                                            maximumFractionDigits: 1
                                                    }
                                            ).format(value) + " ₫";
                                            }
                                    }
                            }
                    }
            }
    });
    }
</script>





<!-- ================= ORDER STATUS CHART ================= -->

<script>
    // Lấy dữ liệu trạng thái đơn hàng từ Servlet
    const orderStatusData = [
    <c:forEach var="row"
               items="${orderStatusStatistics}"
               varStatus="loop">
    {
    status: "${row[0]}",
            total: ${row[1]}
    }<c:if test="${!loop.last}">,</c:if>
    </c:forEach>
    ];
    // Tên tiếng Việt cho từng trạng thái
    const statusNames = {
    "PENDING_CONFIRMATION": "Chờ xác nhận",
            "CONFIRMED": "Đã xác nhận",
            "PACKING": "Đang đóng gói",
            "SHIPPING": "Đang giao",
            "COMPLETED": "Hoàn thành",
            "CANCELLED": "Đã hủy"
    };
    // Màu sắc cho từng trạng thái
    const statusColors = {
    "PENDING_CONFIRMATION": "#f59e0b",
            "CONFIRMED": "#3b82f6",
            "PACKING": "#8b5cf6",
            "SHIPPING": "#06b6d4",
            "COMPLETED": "#22c55e",
            "CANCELLED": "#ef4444"
    };
    // Chuẩn bị dữ liệu cho biểu đồ
    const orderStatusLabels = orderStatusData.map(
            item => statusNames[item.status] || item.status
            );
    const orderStatusValues = orderStatusData.map(
            item => Number(item.total)
            );
    const orderStatusColors = orderStatusData.map(
            item => statusColors[item.status] || "#94a3b8"
            );
    // Tổng số đơn hàng từ database
    const totalOrdersInChart = orderStatusValues.reduce(
            (sum, value) => sum + value, 0
            );
    // Plugin hiển thị tổng đơn giữa Doughnut
    const centerTotalPlugin = {
    id: "centerTotal",
            afterDraw(chart) {
    const {ctx} = chart;
    const meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(0);
    if (!meta.data || meta.data.length === 0) {
    return;
    }

    const centerX = meta.data[0].x;
    const centerY = meta.data[0].y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    // Hiển thị số tổng đơn
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
    ctx.font = "700 30px Inter, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(
            totalOrdersInChart,
            centerX,
            centerY - 10
            );
    // Hiển thị chữ Tổng đơn
    ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
    ctx.font = "12px Inter, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(
            "Tổng đơn",
            centerX,
            centerY + 18
            );
    ctx.restore();
    }
    };
    // Khởi tạo biểu đồ Doughnut
    new Chart(
            document.getElementById("orderStatusChart"),
    {
    type: "doughnut",
            // Đăng ký plugin
            plugins: [centerTotalPlugin],
            data: {
            labels: orderStatusLabels,
                    datasets: [{
                    data: orderStatusValues,
                            backgroundColor: orderStatusColors,
                            borderColor: "#ffffff",
                            borderWidth: 3,
                            hoverOffset: 8
                    }]
            },
            options: {
            responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: "68%",
                    plugins: {
                    legend: {
                    position: "bottom",
                            labels: {
                            usePointStyle: true,
                                    boxWidth: 10,
                                    padding: 15,
                                    font: {
                                    size: 12
                                    }
                            }
                    },
                            tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                            const count = context.parsed;
                            const percent =
                                    totalOrdersInChart > 0
                                    ? (
                                            count / totalOrdersInChart * 100
                                            ).toFixed(1)
                                    : "0.0";
                            return " " + context.label
                                    + ": " + count
                                    + " đơn (" + percent + "%)";
                            }
                            }
                            }
                    }
            }
    }
    );
</script>

                    <script>
                        document.querySelectorAll(".notification").forEach(function (message) {
                            setTimeout(function () {
                                message.classList.add("notification-hide");

                                setTimeout(function () {
                                    message.remove();
                                }, 300);
                            }, 3500);
                        });


                        let cancelForm = null;

                        function showCancelModal(event) {
                            event.preventDefault();

                            cancelForm = event.currentTarget;

                            document.getElementById("cancelModal").classList.add("show");

                            return false;
                        }

                        function closeCancelModal() {
                            document.getElementById("cancelModal").classList.remove("show");

                            const button = document.querySelector(".modal-btn-danger");
                            button.disabled = false;
                            button.textContent = "Xác nhận hủy";

                            cancelForm = null;
                        }

                        function confirmCancelOrder() {
                            if (cancelForm) {
                                const form = cancelForm;
                                cancelForm = null;

                                const button = document.querySelector(".modal-btn-danger");
                                button.disabled = true;
                                button.textContent = "Đang xử lý...";

                                form.submit();
                            }
                        }

                        document.getElementById("cancelModal").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                            if (event.target === this) {
                                closeCancelModal();
                            }
                        });

                        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                            if (event.key === "Escape") {
                                closeCancelModal();
                            }
                        });

                    </script>

                                                </span>
                                            </c:when>
                                            <c:otherwise>

                                            </c:otherwise>
                                        </c:choose>

                                        </a>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>

<!-- =====================================
     REPORT JAVASCRIPT
     ===================================== -->

<script>
    (function () {

        function initReportPage() {

            const reportPage =
                    document.querySelector(".oecs-report");

            if (!reportPage || reportPage.dataset.initialized === "true") {
                return;
            }

            reportPage.dataset.initialized = "true";

            const filterForm =
                    document.getElementById("reportFilterForm");

            const startInput =
                    document.getElementById("startDate");

            const endInput =
                    document.getElementById("endDate");

            const exportButton =
                    document.getElementById("exportButton");

            const exportMenu =
                    document.getElementById("exportMenu");

            const hasServerFilterError =
    ${not empty filterError};

            // =====================================
            // 1. INITIALIZE DATE PICKERS
            // =====================================

            if (typeof flatpickr === "function") {

                const datePickerOptions = {

                    // Value sent to Java Servlet
                    dateFormat: "Y-m-d",

                    // Show date as DD/MM/YYYY
                    altInput: true,
                    altInputClass: "rp-date-input",
                    altFormat: "d/m/Y",

                    allowInput: false,
                    clickOpens: true,
                    disableMobile: true,

                    locale: flatpickr.l10ns.vn || "default",

                    // Calendar outside cards to avoid clipping
                    appendTo: document.body,

                    onReady: function (
                            selectedDates,
                            dateStr,
                            instance) {

                        if (instance.altInput) {

                            instance.altInput.style.cursor = "pointer";

                            instance.altInput.addEventListener(
                                    "click",
                                    function () {
                                        instance.open();
                                    }
                            );

                        }
                    }
                };

                // Initialize once per input.
                // On every new GET request, JSP renders new inputs.
                if (!startInput._flatpickr) {
                    flatpickr(startInput, datePickerOptions);
                }

                if (!endInput._flatpickr) {
                    flatpickr(endInput, datePickerOptions);
                }

            } else {
                console.warn(
                        "Flatpickr could not be loaded. Date picker unavailable."
                        );
            }

            // =====================================
            // 2. ORIGINAL FILTERED DATES
            // =====================================

            // Original inputs retain Y-m-d values.
            const loadedStart = startInput.value;
            const loadedEnd = endInput.value;

            // =====================================
            // 3. FORMAT MONEY AND NUMBERS
            // =====================================

            const numberFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(
                    "vi-VN",
                    {
                        maximumFractionDigits: 0
                    }
            );

            reportPage.querySelectorAll(".js-money")
                    .forEach(function (element) {

                        const value =
                                Number(element.dataset.money);

                        if (Number.isFinite(value)) {

                            element.textContent =
                                    numberFormatter.format(value);

                        }
                    });

            reportPage.querySelectorAll(".js-number")
                    .forEach(function (element) {

                        const value =
                                Number(element.dataset.number);

                        if (Number.isFinite(value)) {

                            element.textContent =
                                    numberFormatter.format(value);

                        }
                    });

            // =====================================
            // 4. FORMAT DISPLAYED DATES
            // =====================================

            function formatDisplayDate(isoDate) {

                if (!isoDate) {
                    return "";
                }

                const value = isoDate.trim().substring(0, 10);

                const parts = value.split("-");

                if (parts.length !== 3) {
                    return isoDate;
                }

                return parts[2] + "/"
                        + parts[1] + "/"
                        + parts[0];
            }

            reportPage.querySelectorAll(".js-display-date")
                    .forEach(function (element) {

                        element.textContent =
                                formatDisplayDate(element.textContent);

                    });

            // =====================================
            // 5. VALIDATE DATE RANGE
            // =====================================


            function validateDateRange() {

                const startDate = startInput.value;
                const endDate = endInput.value;

                const errorBox =
                        document.getElementById("dateRangeError");

                const errorText =
                        document.getElementById("dateRangeErrorText");

                if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                    errorText.textContent =
                            "Vui lòng chọn đầy đủ ngày bắt đầu và ngày kết thúc.";

                    errorBox.style.display = "flex";
                    return false;
                }

                if (startDate > endDate) {
                    errorText.textContent =
                            "Ngày bắt đầu không được lớn hơn ngày kết thúc. Vui lòng chọn lại.";

                    errorBox.style.display = "flex";
                    return false;
                }

                errorBox.style.display = "none";
                return true;
            }


            function clearDateError() {
                document.getElementById("dateRangeError")
                        .style.display = "none";
            }

            [startInput, endInput].forEach(function (input) {
                input.addEventListener("change", clearDateError);
            });



            // =====================================
            // 6. SUBMIT FILTER
            // =====================================

            filterForm.addEventListener(
                    "submit",
                    function (event) {

                        if (!validateDateRange()) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                        }

                    }
            );

            // =====================================
            // 7. EXPORT MENU
            // =====================================

            function closeExportMenu() {

                exportMenu.classList.remove("show");

                exportButton.setAttribute(
                        "aria-expanded",
                        "false"
                        );
            }

            exportButton.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function (event) {

                        event.stopPropagation();

                        if (!validateDateRange()) {
                            closeExportMenu();
                            return;
                        }

                        // Prevent exporting an old filtered range
                        if (
                                hasServerFilterError ||
                                startInput.value !== loadedStart ||
                                endInput.value !== loadedEnd
                                ) {

                            closeExportMenu();

                            alert(
                                    "Vui lòng nhấn Lọc báo cáo trước khi xuất file."
                                    );

                            return;
                        }

                        const isOpen =
                                exportMenu.classList.toggle("show");

                        exportButton.setAttribute(
                                "aria-expanded",
                                String(isOpen)
                                );

                    }
            );

            exportMenu.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function (event) {
                        event.stopPropagation();
                    }
            );

            document.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    closeExportMenu
                    );

            document.addEventListener(
                    "keydown",
                    function (event) {

                        if (event.key === "Escape") {
                            closeExportMenu();
                        }

                    }
            );

            // =====================================
            // 8. ORDER STATUS PROGRESS
            // =====================================

            const statusItems = Array.from(
                    reportPage.querySelectorAll(".rp-status-item")
                    );

            let totalOrders = 0;

            statusItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const count =
                        Number(item.dataset.statusCount) || 0;

                totalOrders += count;

            });

            statusItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const count =
                        Number(item.dataset.statusCount) || 0;

                const percent = totalOrders > 0
                        ? (count / totalOrders) * 100
                        : 0;

                const progress =
                        item.querySelector(".rp-progress-fill");

                const label =
                        item.querySelector(".rp-percent");

                if (progress) {
                    progress.style.width = percent + "%";
                }

                if (label) {
                    label.textContent =
                            percent.toFixed(1) + "%";
                }

            });

            // =====================================
            // 9. TOP PRODUCTS BARS
            // =====================================

            const productItems = Array.from(
                    reportPage.querySelectorAll(".rp-product-item")
                    );

            let maxSold = 0;

            productItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const sold =
                        Number(item.dataset.productSold) || 0;

                if (sold > maxSold) {
                    maxSold = sold;
                }

            });

            productItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const sold =
                        Number(item.dataset.productSold) || 0;

                const percent = maxSold > 0
                        ? (sold / maxSold) * 100
                        : 0;

                const bar =
                        item.querySelector(".rp-product-fill");

                if (bar) {
                    bar.style.width = percent + "%";
                }

            });

        }

        // Works whether the script loads before or after
        // DOMContentLoaded.
        if (document.readyState === "loading") {

            document.addEventListener(
                    "DOMContentLoaded",
                    initReportPage
                    );

        } else {

            initReportPage();

        }

    })();
</script>

                                                    value="${item.cartItemId}">

                                                    name="quantity"

<!-- =====================================================
     JAVASCRIPT
     ===================================================== -->

<script>

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {


        /* =================================================
           ELEMENTS
           ================================================= */

        const selectAll =
            document.getElementById(
                "selectAll"
            );


        const bottomSelectAll =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomSelectAll"
            );


        const checkboxes =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".cart-checkbox:not(:disabled)"
            );


        const topSelectedCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "topSelectedCount"
            );


        const bottomSelectedCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomSelectedCount"
            );


        const bottomProductCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomProductCount"
            );


        const bottomTotalPrice =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomTotalPrice"
            );


        const bottomCheckoutForm =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomCheckoutForm"
            );


        const bottomCheckoutBtn =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomCheckoutBtn"
            );


        const bottomDeleteSelected =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomDeleteSelected"
            );


        const quantityInputs =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".auto-quantity"
            );


        /* =================================================
           MONEY FORMAT
           ================================================= */

        function money(value) {

            return new Intl.NumberFormat(
                "vi-VN"
            ).format(
                Math.round(value)
            ) + " đ";
        }


        /* =================================================
           SELECTED COUNT
           ================================================= */

        function getSelectedCount() {

            let count = 0;


            checkboxes.forEach(
                function (checkbox) {

                    if (checkbox.checked) {

                        count++;
                    }
                }
            );


            return count;
        }


        /* =================================================
           SELECTED TOTAL
           ================================================= */

        function getSelectedTotal() {

            let total = 0;


            checkboxes.forEach(
                function (checkbox) {

                    if (checkbox.checked) {

                        total += Number(
                            checkbox.dataset.subtotal
                            || 0
                        );
                    }
                }
            );


            return total;
        }


        /* =================================================
           UPDATE UI
           ================================================= */

        function updateSummary() {


            const count =
                getSelectedCount();


            const total =
                getSelectedTotal();


            /*
             * Top card
             */
            if (topSelectedCount) {

                topSelectedCount.textContent =
                    count;
            }


            /*
             * Bottom count
             */
            if (bottomSelectedCount) {

                bottomSelectedCount.textContent =
                    count;
            }


            if (bottomProductCount) {

                bottomProductCount.textContent =
                    count;
            }


            /*
             * Bottom total
             */
            if (bottomTotalPrice) {

                bottomTotalPrice.textContent =
                    money(total);
            }


            /*
             * Buy button
             */
            if (bottomCheckoutBtn) {

                bottomCheckoutBtn.disabled =
                    count === 0;
            }


            /*
             * Top select all
             */
            if (selectAll) {


                selectAll.checked =
                    checkboxes.length > 0
                    && count === checkboxes.length;


                selectAll.indeterminate =
                    count > 0
                    && count < checkboxes.length;
            }


            /*
             * Bottom select all
             */
            if (bottomSelectAll) {


                bottomSelectAll.checked =
                    checkboxes.length > 0
                    && count === checkboxes.length;


                bottomSelectAll.indeterminate =
                    count > 0
                    && count < checkboxes.length;
            }
        }


        /* =================================================
           TOP SELECT ALL
           ================================================= */

        if (selectAll) {


            selectAll.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function () {


                    checkboxes.forEach(
                        function (checkbox) {

                            checkbox.checked =
                                selectAll.checked;
                        }
                    );


                    updateSummary();
                }
            );
        }


        /* =================================================
           BOTTOM SELECT ALL
           ================================================= */

        if (bottomSelectAll) {


            bottomSelectAll.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function () {


                    checkboxes.forEach(
                        function (checkbox) {

                            checkbox.checked =
                                bottomSelectAll.checked;
                        }
                    );


                    updateSummary();
                }
            );
        }


        /* =================================================
           EACH PRODUCT CHECKBOX
           ================================================= */

        checkboxes.forEach(
            function (checkbox) {


                checkbox.addEventListener(
                    "change",
                    function () {

                        updateSummary();
                    }
                );
            }
        );


        /* =================================================
           AUTO UPDATE QUANTITY
           ================================================= */

        quantityInputs.forEach(
            function (input) {


                let timer = null;


                input.addEventListener(
                    "input",
                    function () {


                        clearTimeout(timer);


                        const value =
                            Number(
                                input.value
                            );


                        const min =
                            Number(
                                input.min
                                || 1
                            );


                        const max =
                            Number(
                                input.max
                                || 0
                            );


                        const oldValue =
                            Number(
                                input.dataset.oldValue
                                || 0
                            );


                        /*
                         * Không hợp lệ
                         */
                        if (!Number.isInteger(value)
                                || value < min
                                || value > max) {

                            return;
                        }


                        /*
                         * Không thay đổi
                         */
                        if (value === oldValue) {

                            return;
                        }


                        /*
                         * Chờ 500ms để tránh submit liên tục.
                         */
                        timer =
                            setTimeout(
                                function () {

                                    if (input.form) {

                                        input.form.submit();
                                    }

                                },
                                500
                            );

                    }
                );


                /*
                 * Nếu người dùng nhập vượt giới hạn
                 * rồi rời khỏi ô thì đưa về giá trị hợp lệ.
                 */
                input.addEventListener(
                    "blur",
                    function () {


                        let value =
                            Number(
                                input.value
                            );


                        const min =
                            Number(
                                input.min
                                || 1
                            );


                        const max =
                            Number(
                                input.max
                                || 1
                            );


                        if (!Number.isFinite(value)
                                || value < min) {

                            input.value =
                                min;

                        } else if (value > max) {

                            input.value =
                                max;
                        }
                    }
                );
            }
        );


        /* =================================================
           ATTACH SELECTED ITEMS
           ================================================= */

        function attachSelectedItems(
                form) {


            /*
             * Xóa hidden input cũ.
             */
            form.querySelectorAll(
                ".dynamic-selected-item"
            ).forEach(
                function (input) {

                    input.remove();
                }
            );


            /*
             * Lấy checkbox được chọn.
             */
            const selected =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".cart-checkbox:checked:not(:disabled)"
                );


            /*
             * Gắn selectedItems vào form.
             */
            selected.forEach(
                function (checkbox) {


                    const input =
                        document.createElement(
                            "input"
                        );


                    input.type =
                        "hidden";


                    input.name =
                        "selectedItems";


                    input.value =
                        checkbox.value;


                    input.className =
                        "dynamic-selected-item";


                    form.appendChild(
                        input
                    );
                }
            );


            return selected.length;
        }


        /* =================================================
           CHECKOUT
           ================================================= */

        if (bottomCheckoutForm) {


            bottomCheckoutForm.addEventListener(
                "submit",
                function (event) {


                    const selectedLength =
                        attachSelectedItems(
                            bottomCheckoutForm
                        );


                    if (selectedLength === 0) {


                        event.preventDefault();


                        alert(
                            "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm để đặt hàng."
                        );
                    }
                }
            );
        }


        /* =================================================
           DELETE SELECTED
           ================================================= */

        if (bottomDeleteSelected) {


            bottomDeleteSelected.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {


                    const selected =
                        document.querySelectorAll(
                            ".cart-checkbox:checked:not(:disabled)"
                        );


                    /*
                     * Chưa chọn sản phẩm.
                     */
                    if (selected.length === 0) {


                        alert(
                            "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm cần xóa."
                        );


                        return;
                    }


                    /*
                     * Confirm.
                     */
                    if (!confirm(
                            "Bạn có chắc muốn xóa "
                            + selected.length
                            + " sản phẩm đã chọn?"
                    )) {


                        return;
                    }


                    /*
                     * Tạo POST form.
                     */
                    const form =
                        document.createElement(
                            "form"
                        );


                    form.method =
                        "post";


                    form.action =
                        "${pageContext.request.contextPath}/cart";


                    /*
                     * action = removeSelected
                     */
                    const actionInput =
                        document.createElement(
                            "input"
                        );


                    actionInput.type =
                        "hidden";


                    actionInput.name =
                        "action";


                    actionInput.value =
                        "removeSelected";


                    form.appendChild(
                        actionInput
                    );


                    /*
                     * selectedItems
                     */
                    selected.forEach(
                        function (checkbox) {


                            const input =
                                document.createElement(
                                    "input"
                                );


                            input.type =
                                "hidden";


                            input.name =
                                "selectedItems";


                            input.value =
                                checkbox.value;


                            form.appendChild(
                                input
                            );
                        }
                    );


                    document.body.appendChild(
                        form
                    );


                    form.submit();

                }
            );
        }


        /* =================================================
           INITIAL
           ================================================= */

        updateSummary();

    }
);

</script>

        <div class="card shadow-sm border-0 rounded-4">
            <div class="card-body p-4 p-md-5">

                <!-- Header -->
                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mb-4 pb-3 border-bottom">
                    <div class="bg-primary bg-opacity-10 text-primary rounded d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center me-3"
                         style="width: 48px; height: 48px;">
                        <i class="bi bi-folder-plus fs-4"></i>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <h4 class="fw-bold mb-0">Thêm Danh Mục Mới</h4>
                        <span class="text-muted fs-7">
                            Nhập thông tin chi tiết để tạo danh mục sản phẩm
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Error message -->
                <c:if test="${not empty errorMessage}">
                    <div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                        <i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle me-2"></i>
                        <c:out value="${errorMessage}"/>
                    </div>
                </c:if>

                <!-- Form -->
                <form action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/category"
                      method="POST">

                                <!-- Actions -->
                                <td class="text-end">
                                    <div class="d-inline-flex gap-1">
                                        <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/category?view=edit&id=${category.categoryId}"
                                           class="btn btn-sm btn-light text-primary border rounded-2 px-2 py-1"
                                           title="Chỉnh sửa">
                                            <i class="bi bi-pencil-square"></i>
                                        </a>

                                        <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/category?view=delete&id=${category.categoryId}"
                                           class="btn btn-sm btn-light text-danger border rounded-2 px-2 py-1"
                                           title="Xóa">
                                            <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                                        </a>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        </c:forEach>
                    </c:when>

                    <c:otherwise>
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="7" class="text-center py-5">
                                <div class="text-muted py-3">
                                    <i class="bi bi-inbox fs-1 d-block mb-2 text-secondary"></i>
                                    <p class="mb-0 fw-medium">
                                        <c:choose>
                                            <c:when test="${not empty keyword}">
                                                Không tìm thấy danh mục phù hợp.
                                            </c:when>
                                            <c:otherwise>
                                                Chưa có danh mục nào.
                                            </c:otherwise>
                                        </c:choose>
                                    </p>
                                    <small class="text-muted">
                                        <c:choose>
                                            <c:when test="${not empty keyword}">
                                                Thử tìm kiếm bằng từ khóa khác.
                                            </c:when>
                                            <c:otherwise>
                                                Nhấn "Thêm danh mục" để bắt đầu tạo dữ liệu.
                                            </c:otherwise>
                                        </c:choose>
                                    </small>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    </c:otherwise>
                </c:choose>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <!-- Pagination -->
    <div class="p-3 border-top d-flex flex-column flex-sm-row justify-content-between align-items-center gap-3 bg-white">
        <span class="text-muted fs-7">
            Hiển thị
            <strong>${startItem}</strong> - <strong>${endItem}</strong>
            trên tổng số <strong>${totalCategories}</strong> danh mục
        </span>

        <c:if test="${totalPages > 1}">
            <c:url var="prevUrl" value="/category">
                <c:param name="view" value="list"/>
                <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage - 1}"/>
                <c:if test="${not empty keyword}">
                    <c:param name="keyword" value="${keyword}"/>
                </c:if>
            </c:url>

            <c:url var="nextUrl" value="/category">
                <c:param name="view" value="list"/>
                <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage + 1}"/>
                <c:if test="${not empty keyword}">
                    <c:param name="keyword" value="${keyword}"/>
                </c:if>
            </c:url>

            <ul class="pagination pagination-sm mb-0">
                <li class="page-item ${currentPage == 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}">
                    <a class="page-link"
                       href="${currentPage > 1 ? prevUrl : '#'}">
                        Trước
                    </a>
                </li>

                <c:forEach begin="1" end="${totalPages}" var="p">
                    <c:url var="pageUrl" value="/category">
                        <c:param name="view" value="list"/>
                        <c:param name="page" value="${p}"/>
                        <c:if test="${not empty keyword}">
                            <c:param name="keyword" value="${keyword}"/>
                        </c:if>
                    </c:url>

                    <li class="page-item ${p == currentPage ? 'active' : ''}">
                        <a class="page-link" href="${pageUrl}">${p}</a>
                    </li>
                </c:forEach>

                <li class="page-item ${currentPage == totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''}">
                    <a class="page-link"
                       href="${currentPage < totalPages ? nextUrl : '#'}">
                        Sau
                    </a>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </c:if>
    </div>
</div>
