                        contextPath
                        + "/category?view=delete&id=" + id
                        + "&error=server"
                );
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/category?view=list"
            );
        }
    }

    // Kiem tra parentId co phai la hau due cua categoryId khong
    private boolean isDescendant(
            CategoryDAO dao, int parentId, int categoryId) {

        Category current = dao.getById(parentId);
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        while (current != null
                && visited.add(current.getCategoryId())
                && current.getParentId() != null) {

            int currentParentId = current.getParentId();

            if (currentParentId == categoryId) {
                return true;
            }

            current = dao.getById(currentParentId);
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Sap xep danh muc theo thu tu cay thu muc
    private List<Category> buildCategoryTree(
            List<Category> categories,
            Map<Integer, Integer> categoryDepths) {

        Map<Integer, List<Category>> children = new HashMap<>();
        List<Category> roots = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<Integer> categoryIds = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        for (Category category : categories) {
            categoryIds.add(category.getCategoryId());

            children.put(
                    category.getCategoryId(),
                    new ArrayList<>()
            );
        }

        // Gom danh muc theo danh muc cha
        for (Category category : categories) {
            Integer parentId = category.getParentId();

            if (parentId == null
                    || !categoryIds.contains(parentId)
                    || parentId == category.getCategoryId()) {
                roots.add(category);
            } else {
                children.get(parentId).add(category);
            }
        }

        // Sap xep cac danh muc cung cap theo ten
        Comparator<Category> byName = Comparator.comparing(
                Category::getCategoryName,
                Comparator.nullsLast(
                        String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                )
        );

        roots.sort(byName);

        for (List<Category> childList : children.values()) {
            childList.sort(byName);
        }

        List<Category> result = new ArrayList<>();

        // Duyet tu danh muc goc xuong cac cap con
        for (Category root : roots) {
            appendCategoryTree(
                    root,
                    0,
                    children,
                    result,
                    categoryDepths,
                    visited
            );
        }

        // Du phong du lieu loi co chu trinh hoac khong co goc
        for (Category category : categories) {
            if (!visited.contains(category.getCategoryId())) {
                appendCategoryTree(
                        category,
                        0,
                        children,
                        result,
                        categoryDepths,
                        visited
                );
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    // Them danh muc va cac cap con theo thu tu duyet cay
    private void appendCategoryTree(
            Category category,
            int depth,
            Map<Integer, List<Category>> children,
            List<Category> result,
            Map<Integer, Integer> categoryDepths,
            Set<Integer> visited) {

        int categoryId = category.getCategoryId();

        if (!visited.add(categoryId)) {
            return;
        }

        result.add(category);
        categoryDepths.put(categoryId, depth);

        List<Category> childList = children.get(categoryId);

        if (childList != null) {
            for (Category child : childList) {
                appendCategoryTree(
                        child,
                        depth + 1,
                        children,
                        result,
                        categoryDepths,
                        visited
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // Kiem tra danh muc co nam trong cay cua danh muc goc khong
    private boolean isInCategoryTree(
            Category category,
            int rootId,
            List<Category> allCategories) {

        Category current = category;
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();

        while (current != null
                && visited.add(current.getCategoryId())) {

            if (current.getCategoryId() == rootId) {
                return true;
            }

            Integer parentId = current.getParentId();

            if (parentId == null) {
                return false;
            }

            Category parent = null;

            for (Category item : allCategories) {
                if (item.getCategoryId() == parentId) {
                    parent = item;
                    break;
                }
            }

            current = parent;
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Dem so danh muc cua cac trang truoc
    private int countDisplayedBeforePage(
            List<Integer> rootIds,
            Map<Integer, List<Category>> categoryGroups,
            int endIndex) {

        int count = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < endIndex; i++) {
            List<Category> group
                    = categoryGroups.get(rootIds.get(i));

            if (group != null) {
                count += group.size();
            }
        }

        return count;
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.AddressDAO;
import dao.CartDAO;
import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.VoucherDAO;

import model.Address;
import model.CartItem;
import model.Order;
import model.User;
import model.Voucher;

import payment.PaymentGateway;
import service.OrderService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "CheckoutServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/checkout"}
)
public class CheckoutServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(CheckoutServlet.class.getName());

    private final CartDAO cartDAO = new CartDAO();
    private final AddressDAO addressDAO = new AddressDAO();
    private final OrderDAO orderDAO = new OrderDAO();
    private final VoucherDAO voucherDAO = new VoucherDAO();
    private final OrderService orderService = new OrderService();

    // Hien thi checkout voi cac san pham da chon
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            redirectToLogin(request, response);
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        String[] values = request.getParameterValues("selectedItems");

        if (values != null) {
            List<Integer> ids = parseSelectedIds(values);

            if (ids.isEmpty()) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm."
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
                );
                return;
            }

            session.setAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds", ids);
        }

        showCheckout(request, response, user);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            if ("selectAddress".equals(action)
                    || "editAddress".equals(action)
                    || "deleteAddress".equals(action)) {

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        401,
                        "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. "
                        + "Vui lòng đăng nhập lại."
                );
            } else {
                redirectToLogin(request, response);
            }
            return;
        }

        if ("addAddress".equals(action)) {
            addAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("selectAddress".equals(action)) {
            selectAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("editAddress".equals(action)) {
            editAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("deleteAddress".equals(action)) {
            deleteAddress(request, response, user);

        } else if ("applyVoucher".equals(action)) {
            applyVoucher(request, response, user);

        } else if ("removeVoucher".equals(action)) {
            removeVoucher(request, response);

        } else if ("placeOrder".equals(action)) {
            placeOrder(request, response, user);

        } else {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Action không hợp lệ."
            );
        }
    }

    // Tai du lieu trang checkout
    private void showCheckout(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        int userId = user.getUserId();
        int cartId = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(userId);

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        List<Integer> selectedIds = getSelectedIds(session);

        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm cần đặt hàng."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        List<CartItem> cartItems = cartDAO.getCartItemsByIds(
                cartId,
                selectedIds
        );

        if (cartItems == null
                || cartItems.isEmpty()
                || cartItems.size() != selectedIds.size()) {

            session.removeAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds");
            session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Một số sản phẩm đã không còn trong giỏ hàng."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        for (CartItem item : cartItems) {
            if (item.getStockQuantity() <= 0
                    || item.getQuantity() > item.getStockQuantity()) {

                session.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Sản phẩm " + item.getProductName()
                        + " không đủ số lượng tồn kho."
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        // Tao token cho cac thao tac checkout
        synchronized (session) {
            if (session.getAttribute("addressAddToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "addressAddToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }

            if (session.getAttribute("addressActionToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "addressActionToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }

            if (session.getAttribute("checkoutToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutToken",
                        UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                );
            }
        }

        List<Address> addresses =
                addressDAO.getAddressesByUser(userId);

        Address selectedAddress = null;
        Object savedId = session.getAttribute("selectedAddressId");

        if (savedId instanceof Integer) {
            selectedAddress = addressDAO.getAddressById(
                    (Integer) savedId,
                    userId
            );
        }

        if (selectedAddress == null
                && addresses != null
                && !addresses.isEmpty()) {

            selectedAddress = addresses.get(0);
        }

        if (selectedAddress != null) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "selectedAddressId",
                    selectedAddress.getAddressId()
            );
        } else {
            session.removeAttribute("selectedAddressId");
        }

        double subtotal = calculateSubtotal(cartItems);
        double shippingFee = 0;
        double discount = 0;

        Voucher appliedVoucher =
                (Voucher) session.getAttribute("appliedVoucher");

        // Kiem tra lai voucher theo cac san pham dang checkout
        if (appliedVoucher != null) {
            Voucher valid = voucherDAO.getValidVoucher(
                    appliedVoucher.getCode(),
                    subtotal,
                    userId
            );

            if (valid != null) {
                appliedVoucher = valid;

                discount = voucherDAO.calculateDiscount(
                        valid,
                        subtotal
                );

                session.setAttribute("appliedVoucher", valid);
            } else {
                appliedVoucher = null;
                session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");

                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutError",
                        "Voucher đã chọn không còn phù hợp "
                        + "với đơn hàng này."
                );
            }
        }

        List<Voucher> availableVouchers =
                voucherDAO.getAvailableVouchers(subtotal, userId);

        request.setAttribute("cartItems", cartItems);
        request.setAttribute("addresses", addresses);
        request.setAttribute("selectedAddress", selectedAddress);
        request.setAttribute("availableVouchers", availableVouchers);
        request.setAttribute("appliedVoucher", appliedVoucher);
        request.setAttribute("subtotal", subtotal);
        request.setAttribute("shippingFee", shippingFee);
        request.setAttribute("discount", discount);

        request.setAttribute(
                "totalAmount",
                Math.max(0, subtotal + shippingFee - discount)
        );

        // Chi bat cong sandbox khi da co cau hinh
        request.setAttribute(
                "vnpayAvailable",
                PaymentGateway.available("VNPAY")
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "momoAvailable",
                PaymentGateway.available("MOMO")
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/checkout/checkout.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    // Them dia chi va chon lam dia chi mac dinh
    private void addAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String submittedToken = request.getParameter("addressAddToken");

        synchronized (session) {
            String expectedToken =
                    (String) session.getAttribute("addressAddToken");

            if (expectedToken == null
                    || submittedToken == null
                    || !expectedToken.equals(submittedToken)) {

                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutError",
                        "Yêu cầu thêm địa chỉ đã được xử lý "
                        + "hoặc hết hạn."
                );

                redirectToCheckout(request, response);
                return;
            }

            session.removeAttribute("addressAddToken");
        }

        String name = request.getParameter("recipientName");
        String phone = request.getParameter("phoneNumber");
        String line = request.getParameter("addressLine");

        if (!validAddressInput(name, phone, line)) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Thông tin địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectToCheckout(request, response);
            return;
        }

        int newId = addressDAO.insertAddress(
                user.getUserId(),
                name.trim(),
                phone.trim(),
                line.trim()
        );

        if (newId > 0) {
            session.setAttribute("selectedAddressId", newId);

            try {
                if (!addressDAO.setDefaultAddress(
                        newId,
                        user.getUserId()
                )) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không lưu được địa chỉ mặc định."
                    );
                }

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Không lưu được địa chỉ mặc định mới.",
                        e
                );

                session.setAttribute(
                        "checkoutError",
                        "Đã thêm địa chỉ nhưng chưa lưu được "
                        + "địa chỉ mặc định. Vui lòng chọn lại địa chỉ."
                );

                redirectToCheckout(request, response);
                return;
            }

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutMessage",
                    "Đã thêm địa chỉ thành công."
            );

        } else {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Không thể thêm địa chỉ."
            );
        }

        redirectToCheckout(request, response);
    }

    // Chon dia chi bang AJAX
    private void selectAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (!validAddressActionToken(request, session)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu chọn địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("addressId")
        );

        if (addressId <= 0) {
            sendJsonError(response, 400, "ID địa chỉ không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            Address address = addressDAO.getAddressById(
                    addressId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (address == null) {
                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        404,
                        "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                );
                return;
            }

            try {
                if (!addressDAO.setDefaultAddress(
                        addressId,
                        user.getUserId()
                )) {
                    sendJsonError(
                            response,
                            404,
                            "Địa chỉ không còn khả dụng."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                session.setAttribute("selectedAddressId", addressId);
                address.setDefaultAddress(true);

                sendSelectedAddressJson(
                        response,
                        addressId,
                        address
                );

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Không lưu được địa chỉ checkout.",
                        e
                );

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        500,
                        "Chưa lưu được địa chỉ đã chọn. "
                        + "Vui lòng thử lại."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // Sua dia chi bang AJAX
    private void editAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (!validAddressActionToken(request, session)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu sửa địa chỉ không hợp lệ. "
                    + "Vui lòng tải lại trang."
            );
            return;
        }

        int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("addressId")
        );

        String name = request.getParameter("recipientName");
        String phone = request.getParameter("phoneNumber");
        String line = request.getParameter("addressLine");

        if (addressId <= 0 || !validAddressInput(name, phone, line)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    400,
                    "Nhập đủ tên (tối đa 100 ký tự), "
                    + "số điện thoại 9–11 chữ số và địa chỉ."
            );
            return;
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            try {
                boolean updated = addressDAO.updateAddress(
                        addressId,
                        user.getUserId(),
                        name.trim(),
                        phone.trim(),
                        line.trim()
                );

                if (!updated) {
                    sendJsonError(
                            response,
                            404,
                            "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                response.setContentType(
                        "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
                );

                String json =
                        "{\"success\":true,"
                        + "\"address\":{"
                        + "\"addressId\":" + addressId + ","
                        + "\"recipientName\":\""
                        + jsonEscape(name.trim()) + "\","
                        + "\"phoneNumber\":\""
                        + jsonEscape(phone.trim()) + "\","
                        + "\"addressLine\":\""
                        + jsonEscape(line.trim()) + "\"}}";

                response.getWriter().write(json);

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi sửa địa chỉ.", e);

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        500,
                        "Không thể lưu địa chỉ. Vui lòng thử lại."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // Xoa dia chi khong duoc chon
    private void deleteAddress(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        if (!validAddressActionToken(request, session)) {
            sendJsonError(
                    response,
                    403,
                    "Yêu cầu xóa địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                request.getParameter("addressId")
        );

        if (addressId <= 0) {
            sendJsonError(response, 400, "ID địa chỉ không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        synchronized (session) {
            Object selected = session.getAttribute("selectedAddressId");

            if (selected instanceof Integer
                    && ((Integer) selected) == addressId) {

                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        409,
                        "Không thể xóa địa chỉ đang chọn. "
                        + "Vui lòng chọn và xác nhận địa chỉ khác trước."
                );
                return;
            }

            boolean deleted = addressDAO.deleteAddress(
                    addressId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            if (!deleted) {
                sendJsonError(
                        response,
                        400,
                        "Không thể xóa địa chỉ này."
                );
                return;
            }

            response.setContentType(
                    "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
            );

            response.getWriter().write(
                    "{\"success\":true,\"deletedId\":"
                    + addressId + "}"
            );
        }
    }

    // Ap dung voucher cho cac san pham duoc chon
    private void applyVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String code = request.getParameter("voucherCode");

        if (code == null || code.trim().isEmpty()) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Vui lòng chọn Voucher."
            );

            redirectToCheckout(request, response);
            return;
        }

        int cartId = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(user.getUserId());

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Giỏ hàng đang trống."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        List<CartItem> items = getSelectedCartItems(session, cartId);
        List<Integer> selectedIds = getSelectedIds(session);

        if (items.isEmpty() || items.size() != selectedIds.size()) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Không tìm thấy đầy đủ các sản phẩm đang Checkout."
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/cart"
            );
            return;
        }

        double subtotal = calculateSubtotal(items);

        Voucher voucher = voucherDAO.getValidVoucher(
                code.trim(),
                subtotal,
                user.getUserId()
        );

        if (voucher == null) {
            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Voucher không hợp lệ, chưa đủ điều kiện "
                    + "hoặc đã hết lượt."
            );

        } else {
            session.setAttribute("appliedVoucher", voucher);

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutMessage",
                    "Áp dụng Voucher " + voucher.getCode()
                    + " thành công."
            );
        }

        redirectToCheckout(request, response);
    }

    private void removeVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");
        session.setAttribute("checkoutMessage", "Đã bỏ Voucher.");

        redirectToCheckout(request, response);
    }

    // Dat hang COD hoac online
    private void placeOrder(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String checkoutToken = request.getParameter("checkoutToken");

        try {
            if (checkoutToken == null
                    || !checkoutToken.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}")) {

                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Phiên đặt hàng không hợp lệ. "
                        + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
                );
            }

            int orderId;

            synchronized (session) {
                // Neu request lap lai thi tra ve don da tao
                Integer existingOrderId = orderDAO.findIdByToken(
                        user.getUserId(),
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (existingOrderId != null) {
                    orderId = existingOrderId;

                } else {
                    Object expectedToken =
                            session.getAttribute("checkoutToken");

                    if (!(expectedToken instanceof String)
                            || !checkoutToken.equals(expectedToken)) {

                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Phiên đặt hàng đã hết hạn. "
                                + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
                        );
                    }

                    // Kiem tra phuong thuc va cau hinh sandbox
                    String method = request.getParameter("paymentMethod");
                    PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(method);

                    int addressId = parsePositiveInt(
                            request.getParameter("addressId")
                    );

                    Object selectedAddressId =
                            session.getAttribute("selectedAddressId");

                    if (addressId <= 0
                            || !(selectedAddressId instanceof Integer)
                            || ((Integer) selectedAddressId) != addressId) {

                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Vui lòng chọn và xác nhận "
                                + "địa chỉ giao hàng."
                        );
                    }

                    List<Integer> selectedIds = getSelectedIds(session);

                    if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm đã chọn."
                        );
                    }

                    Voucher voucher =
                            (Voucher) session.getAttribute("appliedVoucher");

                    String voucherCode = voucher == null
                            ? null
                            : voucher.getCode();

                    // Service tu kiem tra va luu trong transaction
                    orderId = orderService.placeOrder(
                            user.getUserId(),
                            addressId,
                            checkoutToken,
                            voucherCode,
                            selectedIds,
                            method
                    );
                }

                // Chi xoa state cua dung phien checkout vua xu ly
                if (checkoutToken.equals(
                        session.getAttribute("checkoutToken")
                )) {
                    session.removeAttribute("checkoutToken");
                    session.removeAttribute("appliedVoucher");
                    session.removeAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds");
                }
            }

            Order savedOrder = orderDAO.findByIdAndUser(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId()
            );

            // Don online chua tra tien di den trang thanh toan
            // COD hoac don 0 dong giu trang dat hang thanh cong
            String nextPage =
                    savedOrder != null
                    && "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(savedOrder.getOrderStatus())
                            ? "/payment?id="
                            : "/order-success?id=";

            response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER);

            response.setHeader(
                    "Location",
                    response.encodeRedirectURL(
                            request.getContextPath() + nextPage + orderId
                    )
            );

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            session.setAttribute("checkoutError", e.getMessage());
            redirectToCheckout(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi đặt hàng.", e);

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutError",
                    "Chưa xác nhận được kết quả đặt hàng. "
                    + "Vui lòng thử lại."
            );

            redirectToCheckout(request, response);
        }
    }

    // Lay danh sach cart_item_id da chon trong session
    private List<Integer> getSelectedIds(HttpSession session) {
        Object value = session.getAttribute("checkoutSelectedItemIds");

        if (!(value instanceof List<?>)) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Object item : (List<?>) value) {
            if (item instanceof Integer) {
                Integer id = (Integer) item;

                if (id > 0 && !result.contains(id)) {
                    result.add(id);
                }
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private List<CartItem> getSelectedCartItems(
            HttpSession session,
            int cartId
    ) {
        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<Integer> ids = getSelectedIds(session);

        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }

        List<CartItem> items = cartDAO.getCartItemsByIds(cartId, ids);

        return items == null ? new ArrayList<>() : items;
    }

    private List<Integer> parseSelectedIds(String[] values) {
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();

        if (values == null) {
            return list;
        }

        for (String value : values) {
            int id = parsePositiveInt(value);

            if (id > 0 && !list.contains(id)) {
                list.add(id);
            }
        }

        return list;
    }

    private double calculateSubtotal(List<CartItem> items) {
        double total = 0;

        if (items == null) {
            return total;
        }

        for (CartItem item : items) {
            total += item.getPrice() * item.getQuantity();
        }

        return total;
    }

    private boolean validAddressInput(
            String name,
            String phone,
            String line
    ) {
        return name != null
                && !name.trim().isEmpty()
                && name.trim().length() <= 100
                && phone != null
                && phone.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                && line != null
                && !line.trim().isEmpty();
    }

    private boolean validAddressActionToken(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpSession session
    ) {
        String submitted = request.getParameter("addressActionToken");
        Object expected = session.getAttribute("addressActionToken");

        return submitted != null
                && expected instanceof String
                && submitted.equals(expected);
    }

    private void sendSelectedAddressJson(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int addressId,
            Address address
    ) throws IOException {

        response.setContentType("application/json;charset=UTF-8");

        String json =
                "{\"success\":true,"
                + "\"selectedAddress\":{"
                + "\"addressId\":" + addressId + ","
                + "\"recipientName\":\""
                + jsonEscape(address.getRecipientName()) + "\","
                + "\"phoneNumber\":\""
                + jsonEscape(address.getPhoneNumber()) + "\","
                + "\"addressLine\":\""
                + jsonEscape(address.getAddressLine()) + "\","
                + "\"defaultAddress\":"
                + address.isDefaultAddress() + "}}";

        response.getWriter().write(json);
    }

    private void sendJsonError(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int status,
            String message
    ) throws IOException {

        response.setStatus(status);
        response.setContentType("application/json;charset=UTF-8");

        response.getWriter().write(
                "{\"success\":false,\"message\":\""
                + jsonEscape(message) + "\"}"
        );
    }

    private String jsonEscape(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        for (char c : value.toCharArray()) {
            switch (c) {
                case '"':
                    result.append("\\\"");
                    break;

                case '\\':
                    result.append("\\\\");
                    break;

                case '\n':
                    result.append("\\n");
                    break;

                case '\r':
                    result.append("\\r");
                    break;

                case '\t':
                    result.append("\\t");
                    break;

                default:
                    if (c < 0x20) {
                        result.append(
                                String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c)
                        );
                    } else {
                        result.append(c);
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        return result.toString();
    }

    private int parsePositiveInt(String value) {
        try {
            int id = Integer.parseInt(value);
            return id > 0 ? id : -1;

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Object value = session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        return value instanceof User ? (User) value : null;
    }

    private void redirectToLogin(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        request.getSession().setAttribute(
                "redirectUrl",
                request.getContextPath() + "/checkout"
        );

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/login"
        );
    }

    private void redirectToCheckout(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/checkout"
        );
    }
}package controller;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import model.Order;
import model.User;
import service.OrderService;

@WebServlet(name = "CustomerOrderServlet", urlPatterns = {"/my-orders", "/my-orders/detail", "/my-orders/cancel"})
public class CustomerOrderServlet extends HttpServlet {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(CustomerOrderServlet.class.getName());
    private final OrderDAO orders = new OrderDAO();
    private final OrderService service = new OrderService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        User user = customer(request, response);
        if (user == null) return;
        if ("/my-orders/cancel".equals(request.getServletPath())) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
            response.sendError(405);
            return;
        }
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        synchronized (session) {
            if (session.getAttribute("customerOrderToken") == null) {
                session.setAttribute("customerOrderToken", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
            }
        }
        request.setAttribute("statusLabels", OrderService.statusLabels());
        try {
            if ("/my-orders".equals(request.getServletPath())) {
                Map<String, String> tabs = OrderService.purchaseTabs();
                String tab = request.getParameter("status");
                tab = tab == null ? "ALL" : tab.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!tabs.containsKey(tab)) tab = "ALL";
                String query = request.getParameter("q");
                query = query == null ? "" : query.trim();
                if (query.length() > 100) query = query.substring(0, 100);
                Map<String, Long> counts = OrderService.purchaseTabCounts(orders.countPurchasesByStatus(user.getUserId(), query));
                long total = counts.get(tab);
                long pageCount = Math.max(1L, (total + 9) / 10);
                long page = Math.min(pageCount, Math.max(1, positiveId(request.getParameter("page"))));
                List<Order> list = orders.findPurchasePage(user.getUserId(), query,
                        OrderService.statusesForTab(tab), (page - 1) * 10, 10);
                for (Order order : list) order.setOrderStatus(OrderService.normalizeStatus(order.getOrderStatus()));
                List<Integer> ids = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Order order : list) ids.add(order.getOrderId());
                request.setAttribute("orderItems", orders.findItemsForOrders(user.getUserId(), ids));
                request.setAttribute("tabs", tabs);
                request.setAttribute("tabCounts", counts);
                request.setAttribute("activeTab", tab);
                request.setAttribute("query", query);
                request.setAttribute("currentPage", page);
                request.setAttribute("pageCount", pageCount);
                request.setAttribute("resultCount", total);
                request.setAttribute("orders", list);
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/customer-orders/list.jsp").forward(request, response);
            } else {
                int id = positiveId(request.getParameter("id"));
                if (id < 1) { response.sendError(400, "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."); return; }
                Order order = orders.findByIdAndUser(id, user.getUserId());
                if (order == null) { response.sendError(404, "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."); return; }
                order.setOrderStatus(OrderService.normalizeStatus(order.getOrderStatus()));
                request.setAttribute("order", order);
                request.setAttribute("items", orders.findItems(id, user.getUserId()));
                List<Map<String, Object>> history = service.findHistory(id, user.getUserId());
                request.setAttribute("trackingSteps", OrderService.trackingSteps(order, history));
                Collections.reverse(history);
                request.setAttribute("history", history);
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/customer-orders/detail.jsp").forward(request, response);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot load customer orders", ex);
            response.sendError(500, "Chưa tải được đơn hàng. Vui lòng thử lại.");
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        User user = customer(request, response);
        if (user == null) return;
        if (!"/my-orders/cancel".equals(request.getServletPath())) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(405);
            return;
        }
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        String token = request.getParameter("csrfToken");
        if (token == null || !token.equals(session.getAttribute("customerOrderToken"))) {
            response.sendError(403, "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang.");
            return;
        }
        int id = positiveId(request.getParameter("id"));
        if (id < 1) { response.sendError(400, "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."); return; }
        try {
            // Do not reveal whether another customer's order exists.
            if (orders.findByIdAndUser(id, user.getUserId()) == null) {
                response.sendError(404, "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.");
                return;
            }
            boolean changed = service.cancelOrderByCustomer(user.getUserId(), id);
            session.setAttribute("customerOrderMessage", changed
                    ? "Đã hủy đơn hàng và hoàn lại số lượng tồn kho."
                    : "Đơn hàng đã được hủy trước đó.");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            session.setAttribute("customerOrderError", ex.getMessage());
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot cancel customer order", ex);
            session.setAttribute("customerOrderError", "Chưa xác nhận được kết quả hủy. Vui lòng tải lại đơn hàng và thử lại.");
        }
        response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_SEE_OTHER);
        response.setHeader("Location", response.encodeRedirectURL(request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders/detail?id=" + id));
    }

    private User customer(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        Object value = session == null ? null : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");
        if (!(value instanceof User)) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute("redirectUrl", request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders");
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }
        User user = (User) value;
        if (!user.isCustomer()) { response.sendError(403); return null; }
        return user;
    }

    private int positiveId(String value) {
        try { return Math.max(-1, Integer.parseInt(value)); }
        catch (NumberFormatException ex) { return -1; }
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import service.EmailService;
import service.PasswordResetService;

@WebServlet(name = "ForgotPasswordServlet", urlPatterns = {"/forgot-password"})
public class ForgotPasswordServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ForgotPasswordServlet.class.getName());

    private final PasswordResetService passwordResetService
            = new PasswordResetService();

    private final EmailService emailService
            = new EmailService();

    // =====================================================
    // GET - HIỂN THỊ FORM QUÊN MẬT KHẨU
    // =====================================================
    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                .forward(request, response);
    }

    // =====================================================
    // POST - XỬ LÝ YÊU CẦU QUÊN MẬT KHẨU
    // =====================================================
    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String email = request.getParameter("email");

        // Kiểm tra email rỗng
        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Vui lòng nhập email!"
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

        email = email.trim();

        try {
            // Kiểm tra email tồn tại trong hệ thống
            if (!emailService.emailExists(email)) {
                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Email chưa được đăng ký trong hệ thống"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;

            }

            try {

                // =================================================
                // 1. TẠO RESET TOKEN
                // =================================================
                String token
                        = passwordResetService.createResetToken(email);

                if (token != null) {

                    // =============================================
                    // 2. TẠO LINK RESET PASSWORD
                    // =============================================
                    String resetLink = buildResetLink(
                            request,
                            token
                    );

                    // =============================================
                    // 3. GỬI EMAIL
                    // =============================================
                    boolean sent
                            = emailService.sendResetPasswordEmail(
                                    email,
                                    resetLink
                            );

                    if (!sent) {
                        LOGGER.log(
                                Level.WARNING,
                                "Không thể gửi email reset password tới: {0}",
                                email);
                        request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                                .forward(request, response);

                        return;
                    }

                }
                // =============================================
                // 4. GỬI EMAIL THÀNH CÔNG
                // =============================================
                request.setAttribute(
                        "successMessage",
                        "Nếu email tồn tại trong hệ thống, "
                        + "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã được gửi đến email của bạn."
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

            } catch (Exception ex) {

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi xử lý quên mật khẩu!",
                        ex
                );

                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại sau!"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/forgot-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ForgotPasswordServlet.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // TẠO ĐƯỜNG LINK RESET PASSWORD
    // =====================================================
    private String buildResetLink(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String token) {

        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder();

        url.append(request.getScheme())
                .append("://")
                .append(request.getServerName());

        int port = request.getServerPort();

        boolean defaultHttpPort
                = request.getScheme().equals("http")
                && port == 80;

        boolean defaultHttpsPort
                = request.getScheme().equals("https")
                && port == 443;

        if (!defaultHttpPort && !defaultHttpsPort) {
            url.append(":").append(port);
        }

        url.append(request.getContextPath())
                .append("/reset-password?token=")
                .append(
                        URLEncoder.encode(
                                token,
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        )
                );

        return url.toString();
    }
}

package controller;

import dao.UserDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import service.AuditLogService;

@WebServlet(name = "LoginServlet", urlPatterns = {"/login"})
public class LoginServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LoginServlet.class.getName());
    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            // =====================================================
            // 1. KIỂM TRA TRẠNG THÁI ĐĂNG NHẬP TRƯỚC ĐÓ
            // =====================================================
            HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
            if (session != null
                    && session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") != null) {

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/home"
                );

                return;
            }

            // =====================================================
            // 2. HIỂN THỊ TRANG ĐĂNG NHẬP
            // =====================================================
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi tải trang đăng nhập!", e);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Có lỗi hệ thống xảy ra. Vui lòng thử lại sau!");
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
        String username = request.getParameter("username");
        String password = request.getParameter("password");

        try {
            // =====================================================
            // 1. XÁC THỰC TÀI KHOẢN 
            // =====================================================
            UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
            User user = dao.login(username, password);

            if (user == null) {

                auditLogService.log(
                        username,
                        "LOGIN_FAILED",
                        "USER",
                        null,
                        "Invalid username/email or password",
                        request
                );

                request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Sai tài khoản hoặc mật khẩu.");
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

            if (!user.isActive()) {

                auditLogService.log(
                        user,
                        "LOGIN_FAILED",
                        "USER",
                        (long) user.getUserId(),
                        "Login attempt on locked account",
                        request
                );

                request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Tài khoản đã bị khóa.");
                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

            // =====================================================
            // 2. THIẾT LẬP SESSION VÀ CHUYỂN HƯỚNG
            // =====================================================
            HttpSession session = request.getSession();
            session.setAttribute("loggedInUser", user);
            auditLogService.log(
                    user,
                    "LOGIN_SUCCESS",
                    "USER",
                    (long) user.getUserId(),
                    "User logged in successfully",
                    request
            );

            String redirectUrl = (String) session.getAttribute("redirectUrl");
            if (redirectUrl != null) {
                session.removeAttribute("redirectUrl"); // Xóa sau khi dùng xong
                response.sendRedirect(redirectUrl);
            } else {
                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/home");
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi trong quá trình xử lý đăng nhập!", e);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", "Hệ thống gặp sự cố trong quá trình đăng nhập!");
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/login.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "LogoutServlet", urlPatterns = {"/logout"})
public class LogoutServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LogoutServlet.class.getName());

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        processLogout(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {
        processLogout(request, response);
    }

    /**
     * Phương thức tập trung xử lý đăng xuất người dùng
     */
    private void processLogout(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {
        try {
            // =====================================================
            // 1. HỦY SESSION HIỆN TẠI
            // =====================================================
            HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
            if (session != null) {
                session.invalidate();
            }

            // =====================================================
            // 2. TẠO SESSION MỚI VÀ GỬI THÔNG BÁO ĐĂNG XUẤT
            // =====================================================
            HttpSession newSession = request.getSession(true);
            newSession.setAttribute("logoutMessage", "Bạn đã đăng xuất thành công!");

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi xử lý đăng xuất người dùng!", e);
        } finally {
            // =====================================================
            // 3. CHUYỂN HƯỚNG VỀ TRANG ĐĂNG NHẬP
            // =====================================================
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
        }
    }
}package controller;

import dao.NotificationDAO;
import model.Notification;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "NotificationServlet", urlPatterns = "/notification")
public class NotificationServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final NotificationDAO notificationDAO =
            new NotificationDAO();

    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Object user = session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (user instanceof User) {
            return (User) user;
        }

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
                         HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        // Đổi getUserId() nếu model.User của bạn dùng tên getter khác.
        int userId = user.getUserId();
        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        response.setContentType("application/json");
        response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        try {
            if ("count".equals(action)) {
                int count = notificationDAO.countUnread(userId);
                response.getWriter().write(
                        "{\"count\":" + count + "}");
            } else if ("list".equals(action)) {
                List<Notification> list =
                        notificationDAO.findLatest(userId);

                StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("[");
                boolean first = true;

                for (Notification n : list) {
                    if (!first) {
                        json.append(",");
                    }
                    first = false;

                    json.append("{")
                        .append("\"id\":").append(n.getNotificationId())
                        .append(",\"orderId\":")
                        .append(n.getOrderId() == null
                                ? "null" : n.getOrderId())
                        .append(",\"title\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(n.getTitle()))
                        .append("\",\"message\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(n.getMessage()))
                        .append("\",\"read\":")
                        .append(n.isRead())
                        .append(",\"createdAt\":\"")
                        .append(escapeJson(
                                n.getCreatedAt() == null
                                ? "" : n.getCreatedAt().toString()))
                        .append("\"}");
                }

                json.append("]");
                response.getWriter().write(json.toString());
            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            }
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot load notifications.", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
                          HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if (!"read".equals(action)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            return;
        }

        try {
            int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));

            boolean updated = notificationDAO.markAsRead(
                    id, user.getUserId());

            response.setContentType("application/json");
            response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            response.getWriter().write(
                    "{\"success\":" + updated + "}");

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot update notification.", e);
        }
    }

    private String escapeJson(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    .replace("\"", "\\\"")
                    .replace("\n", "\\n")
                    .replace("\r", "\\r")
                    .replace("\t", "\\t");
    }
}package controller;

    @Override

            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED);
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if (!"read".equals(action)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            return;
        }

        try {
            int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));

            boolean updated = notificationDAO.markAsRead(
                    id, user.getUserId());

            response.setContentType("application/json");
            response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
            response.getWriter().write(
                    "{\"success\":" + updated + "}");

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot update notification.", e);
        }
    }

    private String escapeJson(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    .replace("\"", "\\\"")
                    .replace("\n", "\\n")
                    .replace("\r", "\\r")
                    .replace("\t", "\\t");
    }
}package controller;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import dao.PaymentDAO;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "PaymentCallbackServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/payment/vnpay/ipn",
            "/payment/momo/ipn",
            "/payment/vnpay/return",
            "/payment/momo/return"
        }
)
public class PaymentCallbackServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(
                    PaymentCallbackServlet.class.getName()
            );

    private final PaymentDAO payments = new PaymentDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        String path = request.getServletPath();

        // Return hien thi ket qua da xac minh; IPN van cap nhat don hang.
        if (path.endsWith("/return")) {
            showReturnResult(request, response);
            return;
        }

        // VNPay gui IPN bang GET
        if (!"/payment/vnpay/ipn".equals(path)) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        response.setContentType(
                "application/json;charset=UTF-8"
        );

        try {
            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();

            for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> entry
                    : request.getParameterMap().entrySet()) {

                // Chan tham so trung ten
                if (entry.getValue().length != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Tham số callback bị trùng."
                    );
                }

                params.put(
                        entry.getKey(),
                        entry.getValue()[0]
                );
            }

            // Xac minh chu ky truoc khi cap nhat database
            if (!PaymentGateway.verifyVnp(params)) {
                sendVnpResponse(response, "97");
                return;
            }

            String providerCode =
                    params.get("vnp_ResponseCode");

            boolean success =
                    "00".equals(providerCode)
                    && "00".equals(
                            params.get("vnp_TransactionStatus")
                    );

            // So tien VNPay tra ve da nhan 100
            BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(
                    params.get("vnp_Amount")
            ).movePointLeft(2);

            String result = payments.settle(
                    "VNPAY",
                    params.get("vnp_TxnRef"),
                    amount,
                    params.get("vnp_TransactionNo"),
                    providerCode,
                    success
            );

            sendVnpResponse(response, result);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "Không xử lý được VNPay IPN.",
                    e
            );

            sendVnpResponse(response, "99");
        }
    }

    private void showReturnResult(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {
        boolean success = false;
        String message = "Chưa xác minh được kết quả thanh toán. "
                + "Vui lòng kiểm tra trạng thái trong Đơn mua trước khi thử lại.";

        try {
            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, String[]> entry
                    : request.getParameterMap().entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue().length != 1) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tham số callback bị trùng.");
                }
                params.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()[0]);
            }

            boolean vnpay = "/payment/vnpay/return".equals(request.getServletPath());
            boolean verified = vnpay
                    ? PaymentGateway.verifyVnp(params)
                    : PaymentGateway.verifyMomo(params);

            if (verified) {
                success = vnpay
                        ? "00".equals(params.get("vnp_ResponseCode"))
                            && "00".equals(params.get("vnp_TransactionStatus"))
                        : "0".equals(params.get("resultCode"));
                message = success
                        ? "Cổng thanh toán đã xác nhận giao dịch thành công. "
                            + "Cảm ơn bạn đã mua sắm tại OECS!"
                        : "Thanh toán chưa hoàn tất hoặc đã bị hủy. "
                            + "Bạn có thể kiểm tra đơn hàng và thanh toán lại trong Đơn mua.";
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            LOGGER.warning("Không xác minh được kết quả thanh toán trả về.");
        }

        response.setHeader("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
        request.setAttribute("paymentSuccess", success);
        request.setAttribute("paymentResultMessage", message);
        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/checkout/payment-result.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    private void sendVnpResponse(
            HttpServletResponse response,
            String code
    ) throws IOException {

        String message;

        switch (code) {
            case "00":
                message = "Confirm Success";
                break;

            case "02":
                message = "Already confirmed";
                break;

            case "01":
                message = "Order not found";
                break;

            case "04":
                message = "Invalid amount";
                break;

            case "97":
                message = "Invalid signature";
                break;

            default:
                message = "Unknown error";
                break;
        }

        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("RspCode", code);
        body.addProperty("Message", message);

        response.getWriter().write(body.toString());
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");

        // MoMo gui IPN bang POST JSON
        if (!"/payment/momo/ipn".equals(
                request.getServletPath()
        )) {
            response.setHeader("Allow", "GET");
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
            );
            return;
        }

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        try {
            // Gioi han kich thuoc callback
            char[] buffer = new char[16385];

            int total = 0;
            int count;

            Reader reader = request.getReader();

            while (total < buffer.length
                    && (count = reader.read(
                            buffer,
                            total,
                            buffer.length - total
                    )) != -1) {

                total += count;
            }

            if (total > 16384) {
                response.sendError(413);
                return;
            }

            String json = new String(
                    buffer,
                    0,
                    total
            );

            JsonObject body = JsonParser.parseString(
                    json
            ).getAsJsonObject();

            Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();

            for (Map.Entry<String, JsonElement> entry
                    : body.entrySet()) {

                if (entry.getValue().isJsonPrimitive()) {
                    params.put(
                            entry.getKey(),
                            entry.getValue().getAsString()
                    );
                }
            }

            // Xac minh merchant, requestId va chu ky
            if (!PaymentGateway.verifyMomo(params)) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST
                );
                return;
            }

            String providerCode = params.get("resultCode");

            BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(
                    params.get("amount")
            );

            String result = payments.settle(
                    "MOMO",
                    params.get("orderId"),
                    amount,
                    params.get("transId"),
                    providerCode,
                    "0".equals(providerCode)
            );

            // Da xu ly hoac callback lap da thanh cong
            if ("00".equals(result)
                    || "02".equals(result)) {

                response.setStatus(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_NO_CONTENT
                );

            } else {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST
                );
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi database khi nhận MoMo IPN.",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.WARNING,
                    "MoMo IPN không hợp lệ.",
                    e
            );

            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.OrderDAO;
import dao.PaymentDAO;

import model.Order;
import model.User;

import payment.PaymentGateway;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(
        name = "PaymentServlet",
        urlPatterns = {
            "/payment",
            "/payment/action"
        }
)
public class PaymentServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(PaymentServlet.class.getName());

    private final PaymentDAO payments = new PaymentDAO();
    private final OrderDAO orders = new OrderDAO();

    // Kiem tra dang nhap va quyen Customer
    private User customer(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        Object value = session == null
                ? null
                : session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {
            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    "redirectUrl",
                    request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );

            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) value;

        if (!user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN
            );

            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private int getOrderId(HttpServletRequest request) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(
                    request.getParameter("id")
            );
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
