    // =====================================================
    // VALIDATE
    // =====================================================
    private String validateVoucher(
            Voucher voucher,
            boolean isUpdate) {

        // CODE
        if (voucher.getCode() == null
                || voucher.getCode()
                        .trim()
                        .isEmpty()) {

            return "Mã Voucher không được để trống.";
        }

        // DUPLICATE
        boolean duplicate;

        if (isUpdate) {

            duplicate
                    = voucherDAO
                            .existsCodeExceptId(
                                    voucher.getCode(),
                                    voucher.getVoucherId()
                            );

        } else {

            duplicate
                    = voucherDAO
                            .existsCode(
                                    voucher.getCode()
                            );
        }

        if (duplicate) {

            return "Mã Voucher đã tồn tại.";
        }

        // TYPE
        if (!"AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && !"PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                        voucher.getDiscountType()
                )) {

            return "Loại giảm giá không hợp lệ.";
        }

        // VALUE
        if (voucher.getDiscountValue()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giá trị giảm phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        // PERCENT
        if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && voucher.getDiscountValue()
                > 100) {

            return "Phần trăm giảm không được vượt quá 100%.";
        }

        // MAX
        if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(
                voucher.getDiscountType()
        )
                && voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                != null
                && voucher.getMaxDiscount()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giảm tối đa phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        // MIN ORDER
        if (voucher.getMinOrderValue()
                < 0) {

            return "Giá trị đơn tối thiểu không hợp lệ.";
        }

        // DATE
        if (voucher.getValidFrom()
                == null
                || voucher.getValidTo()
                == null) {

            return "Thời gian Voucher không hợp lệ.";
        }

        if (!voucher
                .getValidTo()
                .after(
                        voucher.getValidFrom()
                )) {

            return "Thời gian kết thúc phải sau thời gian bắt đầu.";
        }

        // USAGE
        if (voucher.getUsageLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getUsageLimit()
                <= 0) {

            return "Tổng lượt sử dụng phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        // PER USER
        if (voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                <= 0) {

            return "Giới hạn mỗi User phải lớn hơn 0.";
        }

        if (voucher.getUsageLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                != null
                && voucher.getPerUserLimit()
                > voucher.getUsageLimit()) {

            return "Giới hạn mỗi User không được lớn hơn tổng lượt sử dụng.";
        }

        return null;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // TIMESTAMP
    // =====================================================
    private Timestamp parseTimestamp(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        LocalDateTime dateTime
                = LocalDateTime.parse(
                        value,
                        formatter
                );

        return Timestamp.valueOf(
                dateTime
        );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // NULLABLE DOUBLE
    // =====================================================
    private Double parseNullableDouble(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return Double.parseDouble(
                value.trim()
        );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // NULLABLE INT
    // =====================================================
    private Integer parseNullableInteger(
            String value) {

        if (value == null
                || value.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        return Integer.parseInt(
                value.trim()
        );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SUCCESS
    // =====================================================
    private void setSuccessMessage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession()
                .setAttribute(
                        "successMessage",
                        message
                );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // ERROR
    // =====================================================
    private void setErrorMessage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            String message) {

        request.getSession()
                .setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        message
                );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // REDIRECT LIST
    // =====================================================
    private void redirectList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher"
        );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // REDIRECT CREATE
    // =====================================================
    private void redirectCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher?view=create"
        );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // REDIRECT EDIT
    // =====================================================
    private void redirectEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int voucherId)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/voucher?view=edit&id="
                + voucherId
        );
    }
}
package controller.admin;

import dao.DashboardDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "DashboardServlet", urlPatterns = "/admin/dashboard")
public class AdminDashboardServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private DashboardDAO dashboardDAO;

    @Override
    public void init() {
        dashboardDAO = new DashboardDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setAttribute("totalRevenue",
                dashboardDAO.getTotalRevenue());

        request.setAttribute("totalOrders",
                dashboardDAO.getTotalOrders());

        request.setAttribute("completedOrders",
                dashboardDAO.getCompletedOrders());

        request.setAttribute("totalProductsSold",
                dashboardDAO.getTotalProductsSold());

        // Top 5 sản phẩm bán chạy
        request.setAttribute("topSellingProducts",
                dashboardDAO.getTopSellingProducts());

        // Thống kê trạng thái đơn hàng
        List<Object[]> statistics
                = dashboardDAO.getOrderStatusStatistics();

        request.setAttribute("orderStatusStatistics", statistics);

        int pendingOrders = 0;
        int cancelledOrders = 0;

        for (Object[] row : statistics) {
            String status = row[0] == null
                    ? ""
                    : row[0].toString().trim().toUpperCase();

            int count = ((Number) row[1]).intValue();

            if ("PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(status)) {
                pendingOrders += count;
            } else if ("CANCELLED".equals(status)) {
                cancelledOrders += count;
            }
        }

        request.setAttribute("pendingOrders", pendingOrders);
        request.setAttribute("cancelledOrders", cancelledOrders);

        // Biểu đồ doanh thu
        String startDateText = request.getParameter("startDate");
        String endDateText = request.getParameter("endDate");

        java.time.LocalDate startDate = null;
        java.time.LocalDate endDate = null;

        String dateError = null;

        if (startDateText != null && !startDateText.isBlank()
                && endDateText != null && !endDateText.isBlank()) {

            try {
                startDate = java.time.LocalDate.parse(startDateText);
                endDate = java.time.LocalDate.parse(endDateText);

                if (startDate.isAfter(endDate)) {
                    dateError = "Ngày bắt đầu không được lớn hơn ngày kết thúc.";
                }

            } catch (java.time.format.DateTimeParseException ex) {
                dateError = "Ngày được chọn không hợp lệ.";
            }

        } else if ((startDateText != null && !startDateText.isBlank())
                || (endDateText != null && !endDateText.isBlank())) {

            dateError = "Vui lòng chọn đầy đủ cả hai ngày.";
        }

        request.setAttribute("startDate", startDateText);
        request.setAttribute("endDate", endDateText);
        request.setAttribute("dateError", dateError);

        if (dateError == null && startDate != null) {
            request.setAttribute("revenueByDate",
                    dashboardDAO.getRevenueByDateRange(startDate, endDate));
        } else {
            request.setAttribute("revenueByDate",
                    dashboardDAO.getRevenueByDate());
        }

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/admin/dashboard.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

}
package controller.admin;

import dao.AdminOrderDAO;
import model.Order;
import model.OrderItem;
import dao.NotificationDAO;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "AdminOrderServlet", urlPatterns = "/admin/orders/*")
public class AdminOrderServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderServlet.class.getName());

    private AdminOrderDAO orderDAO;
    private NotificationDAO notificationDAO;

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    public void init() {
        orderDAO = new AdminOrderDAO();
        notificationDAO = new NotificationDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String path = request.getPathInfo();

        if (path != null && "/detail".equals(path)) {
            // 1. CHI TIẾT ĐƠN HÀNG
            try {
                int orderId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                Order order = orderDAO.getById(orderId);
                List<OrderItem> items
                        = orderDAO.getItemsByOrderId(orderId);
                String status = orderDAO.getCurrentStatus(orderId);

                if (status == null && order != null) {
                    status = order.getOrderStatus();
                }

                request.setAttribute("order", order);
                request.setAttribute("items", items);
                request.setAttribute("status", status);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/admin/order-detail.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Order ID không hợp lệ khi xem chi tiết!",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders"
                );

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi khi tải thông tin chi tiết đơn hàng!",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders"
                );
            }

        } else {
            // 2. DANH SÁCH ĐƠN HÀNG
            try {
                List<Order> orders = orderDAO.getList();

                request.setAttribute("orders", orders);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/admin/orders.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi khi lấy danh sách đơn hàng!",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath() + "/admin/dashboard"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("orderId"));
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/admin/orders");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        try {
            String current = orderDAO.getCurrentStatus(orderId);
            String nextStatus = null;
            String successMessage = null;

            if (current != null) {
                current = current.trim().toUpperCase();
            }

            if ("PENDING".equals(current)) {
                current = "PENDING_CONFIRMATION";
            }

            if ("confirm".equals(action)) {

                if ("PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(current)) {
                    nextStatus = "CONFIRMED";
                    successMessage = "Xác nhận đơn hàng thành công!";
                }

            } else if ("changeStatus".equals(action)) {

                String requested = request.getParameter("status");

                if (requested != null) {
                    requested = requested.trim().toUpperCase();
                }

                String expected = null;

                if ("CONFIRMED".equals(current)) {
                    expected = "PACKING";
                } else if ("PACKING".equals(current)) {
                    expected = "SHIPPING";
                } else if ("SHIPPING".equals(current)) {
                    expected = "COMPLETED";
                }

                if (expected != null && expected.equals(requested)) {
                    nextStatus = expected;
                    successMessage = "Cập nhật trạng thái đơn hàng thành công!";
                }

            } else if ("cancel".equals(action)) {

                if ("PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(current)
                        || "CONFIRMED".equals(current)
                        || "PACKING".equals(current)
                        || "SHIPPING".equals(current)) {

                    nextStatus = "CANCELLED";
                    successMessage = "Hủy đơn hàng thành công!";
                }
            }

            if (nextStatus == null) {

                request.getSession().setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Không thể cập nhật! Vui lòng thực hiện đúng trình tự: "
                        + "Confirmed → Packing → Shipping → Completed."
                );

            } else if (orderDAO.transitionStatus(orderId, nextStatus)) {

                request.getSession().setAttribute(
                        "successMessage",
                        successMessage
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                if ("CANCELLED".equals(nextStatus)) {

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "CANCEL_ORDER",
                            "ORDER",
                            (long) orderId,
                            "Cancelled order #" + orderId
                            + " from status " + current,
                            request
                    );

                } else {

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS",
                            "ORDER",
                            (long) orderId,
                            "Changed order #" + orderId
                            + " status from "
                            + current
                            + " to "
                            + nextStatus,
                            request
                    );
                }

                try {
                    boolean notified = notificationDAO
                            .createOrderStatusNotification(orderId, nextStatus);

                    if (!notified) {
                        LOGGER.warning(
                                "Không tạo được thông báo cho đơn hàng #" + orderId
                        );
                    }
                } catch (Exception notificationError) {
                    LOGGER.log(
                            Level.WARNING,
                            "Lỗi tạo thông báo cho đơn hàng #" + orderId,
                            notificationError
                    );
                }

            } else {

                request.getSession().setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Không thể chuyển trạng thái. Vui lòng tải lại đơn hàng!"
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái đơn hàng #" + orderId,
                    e
            );

            request.getSession().setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Thao tác thất bại! Vui lòng kiểm tra lại."
            );
        }

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/admin/orders/detail?id=" + orderId
        );
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import model.Address;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AddressDAO {
    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public AddressDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public AddressDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();
        if (conn == null) throw new SQLException("Khong ket noi duoc database.");
        return conn;
    }

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AddressDAO.class.getName());

    // LAY DANH SACH DIA CHI CHUA BI XOA
    public List<Address> getAddressesByUser(int userId) {
        List<Address> addresses = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT address_id, user_id, recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, address_line, is_default "
                + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    addresses.add(mapAddress(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi lay danh sach dia chi!", e);
        }

        return addresses;
    }

    // LAY DIA CHI VA KIEM TRA QUYEN SO HUU
    public Address getAddressById(int addressId, int userId) {
        String sql = "SELECT address_id, user_id, recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, address_line, is_default "
                + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, addressId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapAddress(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi lay dia chi theo ID!", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    // THEM DIA CHI MOI
    public int insertAddress(
            int userId,
            String recipientName,
            String phoneNumber,
            String addressLine
    ) {
        if (userId <= 0
                || recipientName == null
                || phoneNumber == null
                || addressLine == null
                || recipientName.trim().isEmpty()
                || recipientName.trim().length() > 100
                || !phoneNumber.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                || addressLine.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "(user_id, recipient_name, phone_number, "
                + "address_line, is_default, is_deleted) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setString(2, recipientName.trim());
            ps.setString(3, phoneNumber.trim());
            ps.setString(4, addressLine.trim());

            int rows = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (rows == 1) {
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi them dia chi!", e);
        }

        return -1;
    }

    // SUA DIA CHI CON HOAT DONG VA THUOC DUNG USER
    public boolean updateAddress(
            int addressId,
            int userId,
            String recipientName,
            String phoneNumber,
            String addressLine
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (addressId <= 0
                || userId <= 0
                || recipientName == null
                || recipientName.trim().isEmpty()
                || recipientName.trim().length() > 100
                || phoneNumber == null
                || !phoneNumber.trim().matches("[0-9]{9,11}")
                || addressLine == null
                || addressLine.trim().isEmpty()) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Thông tin địa chỉ không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET recipient_name = ?, phone_number = ?, address_line = ? "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong the ket noi database.");
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setString(1, recipientName.trim());
                ps.setString(2, phoneNumber.trim());
                ps.setString(3, addressLine.trim());
                ps.setInt(4, addressId);
                ps.setInt(5, userId);

                return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // XOA MEM DIA CHI CUA USER
    public boolean deleteAddress(int addressId, int userId) {
        if (addressId <= 0 || userId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET is_deleted = 1, is_default = 0 "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, addressId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() == 1;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Loi xoa dia chi!", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    // CHI MOT DIA CHI HOAT DONG CUA USER DUOC DAT LAM MAC DINH
    public boolean setDefaultAddress(int addressId, int userId)
            throws SQLException {
        String checkSql = "SELECT address_id FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE address_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";
        String updateSql = "UPDATE dbo.ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "SET is_default = CASE WHEN address_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException("Khong the ket noi database.");
            }
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try (PreparedStatement check = conn.prepareStatement(checkSql);
                    PreparedStatement update = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
                // Serialize selections for one account, including separate browser sessions.
                try (PreparedStatement owner = conn.prepareStatement(
                        "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE user_id = ?")) {
                    owner.setInt(1, userId);
                    try (ResultSet rs = owner.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) { conn.rollback(); return false; }
                    }
                }
                check.setInt(1, addressId);
                check.setInt(2, userId);
                try (ResultSet rs = check.executeQuery()) {
                    if (!rs.next()) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                update.setInt(1, addressId);
                update.setInt(2, userId);
                update.executeUpdate();
                conn.commit();
                return true;
            } catch (SQLException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // CHUYEN RESULTSET THANH OBJECT ADDRESS
    private Address mapAddress(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Address address = new Address();

        address.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));
        address.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        address.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        address.setPhoneNumber(rs.getString("phone_number"));
        address.setAddressLine(rs.getString("address_line"));
        address.setDefaultAddress(rs.getBoolean("is_default"));

        return address;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Order;
import model.OrderItem;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AdminOrderDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderDAO.class.getName());

    // =========================================================
    // 1. LẤY DANH SÁCH ĐƠN HÀNG
    // =========================================================
    public List<Order> getList() {

        List<Order> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT o.order_id, "
                + "o.user_id, "
                + "o.address_id, "
                + "o.shipping_partner_id, "
                + "o.total_amount, "
                + "o.shipping_fee, "
                + "o.created_at, "
                + "o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.recipient_phone, "
                + "o.shipping_address, "
                + "o.order_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Order order = new Order();

                order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
                order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));

                order.setShippingPartnerId(
                        (Integer) rs.getObject("shipping_partner_id")
                );

                order.setTotalAmount(
                        rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount")
                );

                order.setShippingFee(
                        rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee")
                );

                order.setCreatedAt(
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at")
                );

                // Status lấy từ ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY
                order.setOrderStatus(
                        rs.getString("order_status")
                );
                order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
                order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
                order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));

                list.add(order);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
            Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(Level.SEVERE,
                            "Lỗi lấy danh sách Order!", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =========================================================
    // 2. LẤY CHI TIẾT ĐƠN HÀNG
    // =========================================================
    public Order getById(int id) {

        String sql = "SELECT o.order_id, "
                + "o.user_id, "
                + "o.address_id, "
                + "o.shipping_partner_id, "
                + "o.total_amount, "
                + "o.shipping_fee, "
                + "o.created_at, "
                + "o.recipient_name, "
                + "o.recipient_phone, "
                + "o.shipping_address, "
                + "h.status AS order_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "OUTER APPLY ( "
                + "    SELECT TOP 1 status "
                + "    FROM ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "    WHERE order_id = o.order_id "
                + "    ORDER BY status_id DESC "
                + ") h "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    Order order = new Order();

                    order.setOrderId(
                            rs.getInt("order_id")
                    );

                    order.setUserId(
                            rs.getInt("user_id")
                    );

                    order.setAddressId(
                            rs.getInt("address_id")
                    );

                    order.setShippingPartnerId(
                            (Integer) rs.getObject("shipping_partner_id")
                    );

                    order.setTotalAmount(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount")
                    );

                    order.setShippingFee(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee")
                    );

                    order.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at")
                    );

                    order.setOrderStatus(
                            rs.getString("order_status")
                    );
                    order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
                    order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
                    order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));

                    return order;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
            Logger.getLogger(AdminOrderDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(Level.SEVERE,
                            "Lỗi lấy Order theo ID!", ex);
        }

        return null;
    }

    // =========================================================
    // 3. LẤY CÁC SẢN PHẨM TRONG ĐƠN
    // =========================================================
    public List<OrderItem> getItemsByOrderId(int orderId) {

        List<OrderItem> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT oi.*, "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "s.sku_code, "
                + "s.stock_quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON s.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    OrderItem item = new OrderItem();

                    item.setOrderItemId(
                            rs.getInt("order_item_id")
                    );

                    item.setOrderId(
                            rs.getInt("order_id")
                    );

                    item.setSkuId(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id")
                    );

                    item.setPrice(
                            rs.getBigDecimal("price")
                    );

                    item.setQuantity(
                            rs.getInt("quantity")
                    );
                    item.setProductName(rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.setSkuCode(rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.setStockQuantity(rs.getInt("stock_quantity"));

                    list.add(item);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy Order Item!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =========================================================
    // 4. LẤY TRẠNG THÁI HIỆN TẠI
    // =========================================================
    public String getCurrentStatus(int orderId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT order_status "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getString("order_status");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy trạng thái Order!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return null;
    }


    private String normalizeStatus(String status) {
        if (status == null) {
            return null;
        }

        switch (status.trim().toUpperCase()) {
            case "PENDING":
            case "PENDING_CONFIRMATION":
                return "PENDING_CONFIRMATION";
            case "CONFIRMED":
                return "CONFIRMED";
            case "PACKING":
                return "PACKING";
            case "SHIPPING":
                return "SHIPPING";
            case "COMPLETED":
                return "COMPLETED";
            case "CANCELLED":
                return "CANCELLED";
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    public boolean transitionStatus(int orderId, String requestedStatus)
            throws SQLException {

        String next = normalizeStatus(requestedStatus);

        if (next == null || "PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(next)) {
            return false;
        }

        String selectSql
                = "SELECT order_status FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        String updateSql
                = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] SET order_status = ? WHERE order_id = ?";

        String historySql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY (order_id, status) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                String current;

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(selectSql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }
                        current = normalizeStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
                    }
                }

                String expectedNext;

                if ("PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(current)) {
                    expectedNext = "CONFIRMED";
                } else if ("CONFIRMED".equals(current)) {
                    expectedNext = "PACKING";
                } else if ("PACKING".equals(current)) {
                    expectedNext = "SHIPPING";
                } else if ("SHIPPING".equals(current)) {
                    expectedNext = "COMPLETED";
                } else {
                    expectedNext = null;
                }

                boolean valid = next.equals(expectedNext)
                        || ("CANCELLED".equals(next)
                        && expectedNext != null);

                if (!valid) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(updateSql)) {
                    ps.setString(1, next);
                    ps.setInt(2, orderId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(historySql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setString(2, next);
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            } finally {
                conn.setAutoCommit(true);
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;

import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class AdminReportDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(AdminReportDAO.class.getName());

    // =====================================================
    // 1. DOANH THU THEO NGÀY
    // =====================================================
    public List<Object[]> getRevenueByDate() {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS report_date, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue, "
                + "COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders "
                + "FROM [ORDER] o "
                + "INNER JOIN ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE h.status = 'Completed' "
                + "AND h.status_id = ( "
                + "    SELECT MAX(h2.status_id) "
                + "    FROM ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h2 "
                + "    WHERE h2.order_id = o.order_id "
                + ") "
                + "GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY report_date";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Object[] row = new Object[3];

                row[0] = rs.getDate("report_date");
                row[1] = rs.getBigDecimal("revenue");
                row[2] = rs.getInt("total_orders");

                list.add(row);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy báo cáo doanh thu theo ngày!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 2. TỔNG DOANH THU
    // =====================================================
    public BigDecimal getTotalRevenue() {

        String sql
                = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) "
                + "FROM [ORDER] o "
                + "INNER JOIN ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE h.status = 'Completed' "
                + "AND h.status_id = ( "
                + "    SELECT MAX(h2.status_id) "
                + "    FROM ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h2 "
                + "    WHERE h2.order_id = o.order_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getBigDecimal(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy tổng doanh thu!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 3. TỔNG ĐƠN HOÀN THÀNH
    // =====================================================
    public int getCompletedOrders() {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM [ORDER] o "
                + "INNER JOIN ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE h.status = 'Completed' "
                + "AND h.status_id = ( "
                + "    SELECT MAX(h2.status_id) "
                + "    FROM ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h2 "
                + "    WHERE h2.order_id = o.order_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy số đơn hoàn thành!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 4. TỔNG SẢN PHẨM ĐÃ BÁN
    // =====================================================
    public int getTotalProductsSold() {

        String sql
                = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN [ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "INNER JOIN ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE h.status = 'Completed' "
                + "AND h.status_id = ( "
                + "    SELECT MAX(h2.status_id) "
                + "    FROM ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h2 "
                + "    WHERE h2.order_id = o.order_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi lấy tổng sản phẩm đã bán!",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.AuditLog;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class AuditLogDAO extends DBContext {

    // Ghi một audit log mới
    public boolean insert(AuditLog log) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG"
                + "(actor_user_id, "
                + "actor_identifier,"
                + "action,"
                + "entity_type, "
                + "entity_id,"
                + "description,"
                + "ip_address)"
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            if (log.getActorUserId() != null) {
                ps.setInt(1, log.getActorUserId());
            } else {
                ps.setNull(1, Types.INTEGER);
            }

            ps.setString(2, log.getActorIdentifier());
            ps.setString(3, log.getAction());
            ps.setString(4, log.getEntityType());

            if (log.getEntityId() != null) {
                ps.setLong(5, log.getEntityId());
            } else {
                ps.setNull(5, Types.BIGINT);
            }

            ps.setString(6, log.getDescription());
            ps.setString(7, log.getIpAddress());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Lấy toàn bộ audit log, log mới nhất trước
    public List<AuditLog> getAll() {

        List<AuditLog> logs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "log_id, "
                + "actor_user_id, "
                + "actor_identifier, "
                + "action, "
                + "entity_type, "
                + "entity_id, "
                + "description, "
                + "ip_address, "
                + "created_at "
                + "FROM AUDIT_LOG "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                AuditLog log = new AuditLog();

                log.setLogId(rs.getLong("log_id"));

                int actorUserId = rs.getInt("actor_user_id");
                if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                    log.setActorUserId(actorUserId);
                }

                log.setActorIdentifier(
                        rs.getString("actor_identifier"));

                log.setAction(
                        rs.getString("action"));

                log.setEntityType(
                        rs.getString("entity_type"));

                long entityId = rs.getLong("entity_id");
                if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                    log.setEntityId(entityId);
                }

                log.setDescription(
                        rs.getString("description"));

                log.setIpAddress(
                        rs.getString("ip_address"));

                log.setCreatedAt(
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                logs.add(log);
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return logs;
    }

    public List<AuditLog> search(
            String keyword,
            String action,
            String entityType) {

        List<AuditLog> logs = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT log_id, actor_user_id, actor_identifier, action, "
                + "entity_type, entity_id, description, ip_address, created_at "
                + "FROM AUDIT_LOG "
                + "WHERE (? IS NULL OR actor_identifier LIKE ? "
                + "OR description LIKE ?) "
                + "AND (? IS NULL OR action = ?) "
                + "AND (? IS NULL OR entity_type = ?) "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchKeyword = null;

            if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {
                searchKeyword = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";
            }

            String actionValue
                    = action == null || action.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : action.trim();

            String entityValue
                    = entityType == null || entityType.trim().isEmpty()
                    ? null
                    : entityType.trim();

            ps.setString(1, searchKeyword);
            ps.setString(2, searchKeyword);
            ps.setString(3, searchKeyword);

            ps.setString(4, actionValue);
            ps.setString(5, actionValue);

            ps.setString(6, entityValue);
            ps.setString(7, entityValue);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    AuditLog log = new AuditLog();

                    log.setLogId(rs.getLong("log_id"));

                    int actorUserId
                            = rs.getInt("actor_user_id");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        log.setActorUserId(actorUserId);
                    }

                    log.setActorIdentifier(
                            rs.getString("actor_identifier"));

                    log.setAction(
                            rs.getString("action"));

                    log.setEntityType(
                            rs.getString("entity_type"));

                    long entityId
                            = rs.getLong("entity_id");

                    if (!rs.wasNull()) {
                        log.setEntityId(entityId);
                    }

                    log.setDescription(
                            rs.getString("description"));

                    log.setIpAddress(
                            rs.getString("ip_address"));

                    log.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    logs.add(log);
                }

            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return logs;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Banner;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class BannerDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(BannerDAO.class.getName());

    public List<Banner> getAll() {
        List<Banner> banners = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER "
                + "ORDER BY display_order, banner_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Banner banner = new Banner();
                banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                banners.add(banner);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get banners", e);
        }

        return banners;
    }

    public List<Banner> getActive() {
        List<Banner> banners = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT banner_id, image_url, alt_text, target_url, "
                + "is_active, display_order, created_at "
                + "FROM BANNER "
                + "WHERE is_active = 1 "
                + "ORDER BY display_order, banner_id";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Banner banner = new Banner();
                banner.setBannerId(rs.getInt("banner_id"));
                banner.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url"));
                banner.setAltText(rs.getString("alt_text"));
                banner.setTargetUrl(rs.getString("target_url"));
                banner.setActive(rs.getBoolean("is_active"));
                banner.setDisplayOrder(rs.getInt("display_order"));
                banner.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                banners.add(banner);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get active banners", e);
        }

        return banners;
    }

    public boolean insert(Banner banner) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO BANNER "
                + "(image_url, alt_text, target_url, is_active, display_order) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, banner.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(2, banner.getAltText());
            ps.setString(3, banner.getTargetUrl());
            ps.setBoolean(4, banner.isActive());
            ps.setInt(5, banner.getDisplayOrder());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot insert banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean update(Banner banner) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BANNER "
                + "SET image_url = ?, alt_text = ?, target_url = ?, "
                + "is_active = ?, display_order = ? "
                + "WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, banner.getImageUrl());
            ps.setString(2, banner.getAltText());
            ps.setString(3, banner.getTargetUrl());
            ps.setBoolean(4, banner.isActive());
            ps.setInt(5, banner.getDisplayOrder());
            ps.setInt(6, banner.getBannerId());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot update banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean updateActive(int bannerId, boolean active) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BANNER SET is_active = ? WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, active);
            ps.setInt(2, bannerId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot change banner status", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public boolean delete(int bannerId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM BANNER WHERE banner_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, bannerId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete banner", e);
            return false;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Brand;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class BrandDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(BrandDAO.class.getName());

    // Lay danh sach tat ca brand
    public List<Brand> getList() {
        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT brand_id, brand_name, logo_url "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Brand brand = new Brand(
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("brand_name"),
                        rs.getString("logo_url")
                );

                list.add(brand);
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot load brand list", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // Tim brand theo ID
    public Brand getById(int id) {
        String sql = "SELECT brand_id, brand_name, logo_url "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot find brand by ID", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    // excludeId = 0: kiem tra khi them moi
    // excludeId = ID hien tai: kiem tra khi cap nhat
    public boolean isNameExists(String name, int excludeId) {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(brand_name))) "
                + "= LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(?))) "
                + "AND brand_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, name.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1) > 0;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot check duplicate brand name", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot check brand name", e);
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Dem so san pham thuoc mot brand
    public int countProductsByBrandId(int brandId) {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, brandId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count products by brand", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot count products", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // Dem so san pham cua nhieu brand trong mot truy van
    public Map<Integer, Integer> getProductCounts(List<Brand> brandList) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts = new HashMap<>();

        if (brandList == null || brandList.isEmpty()) {
            return productCounts;
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT brand_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM PRODUCT "
                + "WHERE brand_id IN ("
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < brandList.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                sql.append(", ");
            }
            sql.append("?");
        }

        sql.append(") GROUP BY brand_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < brandList.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 1, brandList.get(i).getBrandId());
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    productCounts.put(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count products by brands", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot count products by brands", e);
        }

        // Brand khong co san pham se co gia tri 0
        for (Brand brand : brandList) {
            productCounts.putIfAbsent(brand.getBrandId(), 0);
        }

        return productCounts;
    }

    // Them brand moi
    public int insert(Brand brand) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO BRAND (brand_name, logo_url) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, brand.getBrandName());
            ps.setString(2, brand.getLogoUrl());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot insert brand", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot insert brand", e);
        }
    }

    // Cap nhat brand
    public int edit(Brand brand) {
        String sql = "UPDATE BRAND "
                + "SET brand_name = ?, logo_url = ? "
                + "WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, brand.getBrandName());
            ps.setString(2, brand.getLogoUrl());
            ps.setInt(3, brand.getBrandId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot update brand", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot update brand", e);
        }
    }

    // Xoa brand theo ID
    public int delete(Brand brand) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM BRAND WHERE brand_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, brand.getBrandId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete brand", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot delete brand", e);
        }
    }

    // Tim thuong hieu theo ten
    public List<Brand> searchByName(String keyword) {
        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT brand_id, brand_name, logo_url "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?) "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, "%" + keyword.trim() + "%");

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Brand brand = new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    );

                    list.add(brand);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot search brands", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot search brands", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // Lay danh sach brand theo trang
    public List<Brand> getListByPage(int page, int pageSize) {
        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT brand_id, brand_name, logo_url "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, (page - 1) * pageSize);
            ps.setInt(2, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    ));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot load brands by page", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot load brands by page", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // Tim brand theo ten va phan trang
    public List<Brand> searchByNameAndPage(
            String keyword, int page, int pageSize) {

        List<Brand> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT brand_id, brand_name, logo_url "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?) "
                + "ORDER BY brand_id "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, "%" + keyword.trim() + "%");
            ps.setInt(2, (page - 1) * pageSize);
            ps.setInt(3, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    ));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot search brands by page", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot search brands by page", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // Dem tong so brand theo tu khoa
    public int countSearchResults(String keyword) {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM BRAND "
                + "WHERE LOWER(brand_name) LIKE LOWER(?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setNString(1, "%" + keyword.trim() + "%");

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);

            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count searched brands", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot count searched brands", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // Dem tong so thuong hieu
    public int countBrands() {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BRAND";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot count brands", e);
        }
