package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.CartItem;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class CartDAO extends DBContext {

    // =====================================================
    // GET CART ID
    // =====================================================
    public int getCartIdByUserId(int userId) {

        if (userId <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT cart_id "
                + "FROM CART "
                + "WHERE user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("cart_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // CREATE CART
    // =====================================================
    public int createCart(int userId) {

        if (userId <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CART "
                + "(user_id, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(
                             sql,
                             Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            int affected = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (affected <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            int existing
                    = getCartIdByUserId(userId);

            if (existing > 0) {
                return existing;
            }
        }

        return -1;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // GET OR CREATE
    // =====================================================
    public int getOrCreateCart(int userId) {

        int cartId
                = getCartIdByUserId(userId);

        if (cartId > 0) {
            return cartId;
        }

        return createCart(userId);
    }


    // =====================================================
    // GET ALL ITEMS
    // =====================================================
    public List<CartItem> getCartItems(int cartId) {

        List<CartItem> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return list;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ci.cart_item_id, "
                + "ci.cart_id, "
                + "ci.sku_id, "
                + "ci.quantity, "
                + "ps.sku_code, "
                + "ps.price, "
                + "ps.stock_quantity, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapCartItem(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // GET SELECTED ITEMS
    // =====================================================
    public List<CartItem> getCartItemsByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        List<CartItem> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemIds == null
                || cartItemIds.isEmpty()) {

            return list;
        }

        List<Integer> validIds
                = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Integer id : cartItemIds) {

            if (id != null
                    && id > 0
                    && !validIds.contains(id)) {

                validIds.add(id);
            }
        }

        if (validIds.isEmpty()) {
            return list;
        }

        StringBuilder placeholders
                = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0;
             i < validIds.size();
             i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                placeholders.append(",");
            }

            placeholders.append("?");
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "ci.cart_item_id, "
                + "ci.cart_id, "
                + "ci.sku_id, "
                + "ci.quantity, "
                + "ps.sku_code, "
                + "ps.price, "
                + "ps.stock_quantity, "
                + "p.product_name "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = ps.product_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                + "AND ci.cart_item_id IN ("
                + placeholders
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int index = 1;

            ps.setInt(
                    index++,
                    cartId
            );

            for (Integer id : validIds) {

                ps.setInt(
                        index++,
                        id
                );
            }

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapCartItem(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // EXISTS
    // =====================================================
    public boolean exists(
            int cartId,
            int skuId) {

        if (cartId <= 0 || skuId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // STOCK
    // =====================================================
    public int getStockQuantity(int skuId) {

        if (skuId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT stock_quantity "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "stock_quantity"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // CURRENT QUANTITY
    // =====================================================
    public int getCurrentQuantity(
            int cartId,
            int skuId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT quantity "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND sku_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "quantity"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // ADD TO CART
    // =====================================================
    public boolean addToCart(
            int cartId,
            int skuId,
            int quantity) {

        if (cartId <= 0
                || skuId <= 0
                || quantity <= 0) {

            return false;
        }

        int stock
                = getStockQuantity(skuId);

        if (stock <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int current
                = getCurrentQuantity(
                        cartId,
                        skuId
                );

        if (current + quantity > stock) {

            return false;
        }

        if (current > 0) {

            String sql
                    = "UPDATE CART_ITEMS "
                    + "SET quantity = quantity + ? "
                    + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                    + "AND sku_id = ?";

            try (Connection conn = getConnection();
                 PreparedStatement ps
                         = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, quantity);
                ps.setInt(2, cartId);
                ps.setInt(3, skuId);

                return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }

            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "INSERT INTO CART_ITEMS "
                + "(cart_id, sku_id, quantity) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, quantity);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // GET SKU FROM CART ITEM
    // =====================================================
    public int getSkuIdByCartItemId(
            int cartItemId,
            int cartId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT sku_id "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getInt(
                            "sku_id"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // UPDATE QUANTITY
    // =====================================================
    public boolean updateQuantity(
            int cartItemId,
            int cartId,
            int quantity) {

        if (quantity <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int skuId
                = getSkuIdByCartItemId(
                        cartItemId,
                        cartId
                );

        if (skuId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int stock
                = getStockQuantity(skuId);

        if (quantity > stock) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "UPDATE CART_ITEMS "
                + "SET quantity = ? "
                + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, quantity);
            ps.setInt(2, cartItemId);
            ps.setInt(3, cartId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // LEGACY UPDATE
    // =====================================================
    public boolean updateQuantity(
            int cartItemId,
            int quantity) {

        if (quantity <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT ci.cart_id "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return updateQuantity(
                            cartItemId,
                            rs.getInt("cart_id"),
                            quantity
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CLEAR
    // =====================================================
    public boolean clearCart(int cartId) {

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            ps.executeUpdate();

            return true;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // TOTAL CART
    // =====================================================
    public double getCartTotal(int cartId) {

        if (cartId <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT COALESCE("
                + "SUM(ps.price * ci.quantity), 0"
                + ") AS total "
                + "FROM CART_ITEMS ci "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON ps.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, cartId);

            try (ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return rs.getDouble(
                            "total"
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // TOTAL SELECTED ITEMS
    // =====================================================
    public double getCartTotalByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        List<CartItem> items
                = getCartItemsByIds(
                        cartId,
                        cartItemIds
                );

        double total = 0;

        for (CartItem item : items) {

            total += item.getPrice()
                    * item.getQuantity();
        }

        return total;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // DELETE SELECTED ITEMS
    // =====================================================
    public boolean deleteCartItemsByIds(
            int cartId,
            List<Integer> cartItemIds) {

        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemIds == null
                || cartItemIds.isEmpty()) {

            return false;
        }

        StringBuilder placeholders
                = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0;
             i < cartItemIds.size();
             i++) {

            if (i > 0) {
                placeholders.append(",");
            }

            placeholders.append("?");
        }

        String sql
                = "DELETE FROM CART_ITEMS "
                + "WHERE cart_id = ? "
                + "AND cart_item_id IN ("
                + placeholders
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            int index = 1;

            ps.setInt(
                    index++,
                    cartId
            );

            for (Integer id : cartItemIds) {

                ps.setInt(
                        index++,
                        id
                );
            }

            int deleted
                    = ps.executeUpdate();

            return deleted
                    == cartItemIds.size();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }


    // =====================================================
    // MAP
    // =====================================================
    private CartItem mapCartItem(
            ResultSet rs)
            throws SQLException {

        CartItem item
                = new CartItem();

        item.setCartItemId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "cart_item_id"
                )
        );

        item.setCartId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "cart_id"
                )
        );

        item.setSkuId(
                rs.getInt(
                        "sku_id"
                )
        );

        item.setQuantity(
                rs.getInt(
                        "quantity"
                )
        );

        item.setSkuCode(
                rs.getString(
                        "sku_code"
                )
        );

        item.setPrice(
                rs.getDouble(
                        "price"
                )
        );

        item.setStockQuantity(
                rs.getInt(
                        "stock_quantity"
                )
        );

        item.setProductName(
                rs.getString(
                        "product_name"
                )
        );

        return item;
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Category;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class CategoryDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(CategoryDAO.class.getName());

    // Lay toan bo danh muc
    public List<Category> getList() {
        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, category_name ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                list.add(mapCategory(rs));
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get category list", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot get category list", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // Lay danh muc theo ID
    public Category getById(int id) {
        String sql = "SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id "
                + "FROM CATEGORY WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return mapCategory(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get category by ID", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot get category by ID", e);
        }

        return null;
    }

    // Chuyen ResultSet thanh Category
    private Category mapCategory(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Object parentValue = rs.getObject("parent_id");

        Integer parentId = parentValue == null
                ? null : ((Number) parentValue).intValue();

        return new Category(
                rs.getInt("category_id"),
                rs.getString("category_name"),
                parentId
        );
    }

    // Kiem tra ten danh muc da ton tai khi them moi
    public boolean isCategoryNameExists(String categoryName)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(category_name))) = LOWER(?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, categoryName.trim());

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1) > 0;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Kiem tra ten danh muc da ton tai khi sua
    // Bo qua danh muc dang duoc sua
    public boolean isCategoryNameExists(
            String categoryName, int excludeCategoryId)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(category_name))) = LOWER(?) "
                + "AND category_id <> ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, categoryName.trim());
            ps.setInt(2, excludeCategoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1) > 0;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    // Them danh muc
    public int insert(Category category) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO CATEGORY (category_name, parent_id) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, category.getCategoryName());
            setParentId(ps, 2, category.getParentId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot insert category", e);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // Cap nhat danh muc
    public int edit(Category category) {
        String sql = "UPDATE CATEGORY "
                + "SET category_name = ?, parent_id = ? "
                + "WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, category.getCategoryName());
            setParentId(ps, 2, category.getParentId());
            ps.setInt(3, category.getCategoryId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot update category", e);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // Gan parent_id, cho phep de trong neu la danh muc goc
    private void setParentId(
            PreparedStatement ps, int index, Integer parentId)
            throws SQLException {

        if (parentId == null) {
            ps.setNull(index, java.sql.Types.INTEGER);
        } else {
            ps.setInt(index, parentId);
        }
    }

    // Dem tong so danh muc
    public int countCategories() {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count categories", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot count categories", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // Tim kiem danh muc theo ten
    public List<Category> searchByName(String keyword) {
        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, category_name ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, "%" + keyword + "%");

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot search categories", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot search categories", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY "
                + "WHERE category_name LIKE ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, "%" + keyword + "%");

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count search results", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot count search results", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // Lay danh muc theo trang
    public List<Category> getListByPage(int page, int pageSize) {
        List<Category> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id "
                + "FROM CATEGORY "
                + "ORDER BY parent_id ASC, category_name ASC "
                + "OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, (page - 1) * pageSize);
            ps.setInt(2, pageSize);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(mapCategory(rs));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get categories by page", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot get categories by page", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // Lay ten tat ca danh muc theo ID
    public Map<Integer, String> getCategoryNames() {
        Map<Integer, String> names = new HashMap<>();

        String sql = "SELECT category_id, category_name FROM CATEGORY";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                names.put(
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getString("category_name")
                );
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get category names", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot get category names", e);
        }

        return names;
    }

    // Dem so san pham cua cac danh muc tren trang
    public Map<Integer, Integer> getProductCounts(
            List<Category> categories) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();

        if (categories == null || categories.isEmpty()) {
            return counts;
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM PRODUCT WHERE category_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, categories.size());
        sql.append(") GROUP BY category_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < categories.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 1, categories.get(i).getCategoryId());
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get product counts", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot get product counts", e);
        }

        return counts;
    }

    // Dem so danh muc con cua cac danh muc tren trang
    public Map<Integer, Integer> getChildCounts(
            List<Category> categories) {

        Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();

        if (categories == null || categories.isEmpty()) {
            return counts;
        }

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM CATEGORY WHERE parent_id IN ("
        );

        appendPlaceholders(sql, categories.size());
        sql.append(") GROUP BY parent_id");

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < categories.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 1, categories.get(i).getCategoryId());
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(
                            rs.getInt("parent_id"),
                            rs.getInt("total")
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot get child counts", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot get child counts", e);
        }

        return counts;
    }

    // Tao danh sach dau ? cho cau lenh SQL
    private void appendPlaceholders(StringBuilder sql, int count) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                sql.append(", ");
            }
            sql.append("?");
        }
    }

    // Dem so san pham thuoc mot danh muc
    public int countProductsByCategoryId(int categoryId) {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count category products", e);
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count category products", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // Dem so danh muc con cua mot danh muc
    public int countChildCategories(int categoryId) {
        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CATEGORY WHERE parent_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, categoryId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot count child categories", e);
            throw new RuntimeException(
                    "Cannot count child categories", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // Xoa danh muc
    public int delete(Category category) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM CATEGORY WHERE category_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, category.getCategoryId());

            return ps.executeUpdate();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete category", e);
            return 0;
        }
    }

import db.DBContext;
import model.CartItem;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.Statement;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class CheckoutDAO extends DBContext {

    // =====================================================
    // ADDRESS CỦA USER
    // =====================================================
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAddressesByUser(
            int userId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "address_id, "
                + "recipient_name, "
                + "phone_number, "
                + "address_line, "
                + "is_default "
                + "FROM ADDRESSBOOK "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND is_deleted = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps
                     = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    Map<String, Object> address
                            = new HashMap<>();

                    address.put(
                            "addressId",
                            rs.getInt("address_id"));

                    address.put(
                            "recipientName",
                            rs.getString("recipient_name"));

                    address.put(
                            "phoneNumber",
                            rs.getString("phone_number"));

                    address.put(
                            "addressLine",
                            rs.getString("address_line"));

                    address.put(
                            "defaultAddress",
                            rs.getBoolean("is_default"));

                    list.add(address);
                }
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SHIPPING PARTNER
    // =====================================================
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getShippingPartners() {

        List<Map<String, Object>> list

    // =====================================================
    // CREATE ORDER
    // =====================================================
    public int createOrder(
            int userId,
            int addressId,
            Integer shippingPartnerId,
            List<CartItem> items,
            double subtotal,
            double shippingFee,
            double discount,
            Integer voucherId,
            String paymentMethod,
            String checkoutToken) {

        Connection conn = null;

        try {

            conn = getConnection();

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);


            // =================================================
            // 1. KIỂM TRA ADDRESS CỦA USER
            // =================================================

            String addressSql
                    = "SELECT "
                    + "recipient_name, "
                    + "phone_number, "
                    + "address_line "
                    + "FROM ADDRESSBOOK "
                    + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                    + "AND user_id = ? "
                    + "AND is_deleted = 0";

            String recipientName;
            String recipientPhone;
            String shippingAddress;

            try (PreparedStatement ps
                    = conn.prepareStatement(
                            addressSql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, addressId);
                ps.setInt(2, userId);

                try (ResultSet rs
                        = ps.executeQuery()) {

                    if (!rs.next()) {

                        conn.rollback();

                        return -1;
                    }

                    recipientName
                            = rs.getString(
                                    "recipient_name");

                    recipientPhone
                            = rs.getString(
                                    "phone_number");

                    shippingAddress
                            = rs.getString(
                                    "address_line");
                }
            }


            // =================================================
            // 2. KIỂM TRA SẢN PHẨM + STOCK
            // =================================================

            for (CartItem item : items) {

                String stockSql
                        = "SELECT stock_quantity "
                        + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                stockSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(
                            1,
                            item.getSkuId());

                    try (ResultSet rs
                            = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {

                            conn.rollback();

                            return -1;
                        }

                        int stock
                                = rs.getInt(
                                        "stock_quantity");

                        if (stock
                                < item.getQuantity()) {

                            conn.rollback();

                            return -2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }


            // =================================================
            // 3. TỔNG THANH TOÁN
            // =================================================

            double totalAmount
                    = subtotal
                    - discount
                    + shippingFee;

            if (totalAmount < 0) {
                totalAmount = 0;
            }


            // =================================================
            // 4. CREATE ORDER
            // =================================================

            String orderSql
                    = "INSERT INTO [ORDER] ("
                    + "user_id, "
                    + "address_id, "
                    + "shipping_partner_id, "
                    + "total_amount, "
                    + "shipping_fee, "
                    + "order_status, "
                    + "payment_method, "
                    + "payment_status, "
                    + "recipient_name, "
                    + "recipient_phone, "
                    + "shipping_address, "
                    + "discount_amount, "
                    + "checkout_token"
                    + ") "
                    + "VALUES ("
                    + "?, ?, ?, ?, ?, "
                    + "?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?"
                    + ")";

            int orderId;

            try (PreparedStatement ps
                    = conn.prepareStatement(
                            orderSql,
                            Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

                ps.setInt(
                        1,
                        userId);

                ps.setInt(
                        2,
                        addressId);

                if (shippingPartnerId == null) {

                    ps.setNull(
                            3,
                            java.sql.Types.INTEGER);

                } else {

                    ps.setInt(
                            3,
                            shippingPartnerId);
                }

                ps.setDouble(
                        4,
                        totalAmount);

                ps.setDouble(
                        5,
                        shippingFee);

                ps.setString(
                        6,
                        "PENDING_CONFIRMATION");

                ps.setString(
                        7,
                        paymentMethod);

                ps.setString(
                        8,
                        "PENDING");

                ps.setString(
                        9,
                        recipientName);

                ps.setString(
                        10,
                        recipientPhone);

                ps.setString(
                        11,
                        shippingAddress);

                ps.setDouble(
                        12,
                        discount);

                ps.setString(
                        13,
                        checkoutToken);

                int affected
                        = ps.executeUpdate();

                if (affected == 0) {

                    conn.rollback();

                    return -1;
                }

                try (ResultSet rs
                        = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {

                    if (!rs.next()) {

                        conn.rollback();

                        return -1;
                    }

                    orderId
                            = rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }


            // =================================================
            // 5. ORDER ITEM
            // =================================================

            String itemSql
                    = "INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM "
                    + "(order_id, sku_id, price, quantity) "
                    + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

            String stockSql
                    = "UPDATE PRODUCT_SKU "
                    + "SET stock_quantity = "
                    + "stock_quantity - ? "
                    + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                    + "AND stock_quantity >= ?";

            String removeCartSql
                    = "DELETE FROM CART_ITEMS "
                    + "WHERE cart_item_id = ? "
                    + "AND cart_id IN ("
                    + "    SELECT cart_id "
                    + "    FROM CART "
                    + "    WHERE user_id = ?"
                    + ")";


            for (CartItem item : items) {

                // ORDER ITEM
                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                itemSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(
                            1,
                            orderId);

                    ps.setInt(
                            2,
                            item.getSkuId());

                    ps.setDouble(
                            3,
                            item.getPrice());

                    ps.setInt(
                            4,
                            item.getQuantity());

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }


                // TRỪ STOCK
                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                stockSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(
                            1,
                            item.getQuantity());

                    ps.setInt(
                            2,
                            item.getSkuId());

                    ps.setInt(
                            3,
                            item.getQuantity());

                    int updated
                            = ps.executeUpdate();

                    if (updated == 0) {

                        conn.rollback();

                        return -2;
                    }
                }


                // CHỈ XÓA ITEM ĐÃ ORDER
                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                removeCartSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(
                            1,
                            item.getCartItemId());

                    ps.setInt(
                            2,
                            userId);

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            }


            // =================================================
            // 6. ORDER STATUS HISTORY
            // =================================================

            String statusSql
                    = "INSERT INTO "
                    + "ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                    + "(order_id, status) "
                    + "VALUES (?, ?)";

            try (PreparedStatement ps
                    = conn.prepareStatement(
                            statusSql)) {

                ps.setInt(
                        1,
                        orderId);

                ps.setString(
                        2,
                        "Pending");

                ps.executeUpdate();
            }


            // =================================================
            // 7. VOUCHER USAGE
            // =================================================

            if (voucherId != null) {

                String voucherSql
                        = "INSERT INTO "
                        + "VOUCHER_USAGES "
                        + "(voucher_id, order_id, user_id) "
                        + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(
                                voucherSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(
                            1,
                            voucherId);

                    ps.setInt(
                            2,
                            orderId);

                    ps.setInt(
                            3,
                            userId);

                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }
            }


            // =================================================
            // COMMIT
            // =================================================

            conn.commit();

            return orderId;

        } catch (Exception e) {

            e.printStackTrace();

            if (conn != null) {

                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                }
            }

            return -1;

        } finally {

            if (conn != null) {

                try {

                    conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                    conn.close();

                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                }
            }
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class DashboardDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(DashboardDAO.class.getName());

    // =========================
    // 1. TOTAL REVENUE
    // =========================
    public BigDecimal getTotalRevenue() {

        String sql = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED'";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getBigDecimal(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting total revenue",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }

    // =========================
    // 2. TOTAL ORDERS
    // =========================
    public int getTotalOrders() {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER]";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting total orders",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =========================
    // 3. COMPLETED ORDERS
    // =========================
    public int getCompletedOrders() {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED'";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting completed orders",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =========================
    // 4. TOTAL PRODUCTS SOLD
    // =========================
    public int getTotalProductsSold() {

        String sql = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED'";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting total products sold",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =========================
    // 5. REVENUE BY DATE
    // =========================
    public List<Object[]> getRevenueByDate() {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS order_date, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY order_date";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Object[] row = new Object[2];

                row[0] = rs.getDate("order_date");
                row[1] = rs.getBigDecimal("revenue");

                list.add(row);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting revenue by date",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    public List<Object[]> getRevenueByDateRange(
            java.time.LocalDate startDate,
            java.time.LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS order_date, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < DATEADD(DAY, 1, ?) "
                + "GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY order_date";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setDate(1, java.sql.Date.valueOf(startDate));
            ps.setDate(2, java.sql.Date.valueOf(endDate));

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Object[] row = new Object[2];

                    row[0] = rs.getDate("order_date");
                    row[1] = rs.getBigDecimal("revenue");

                    list.add(row);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting revenue by date range", ex);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =========================
    // 6. TOP SELLING PRODUCTS
    // =========================
    public List<Object[]> getTopSellingProducts() {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT TOP 5 "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT_SKU sku "
                + "ON oi.sku_id = sku.sku_id "
                + "INNER JOIN PRODUCT p "
                + "ON sku.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name "
                + "ORDER BY total_sold DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Object[] row = new Object[2];

                row[0] = rs.getString("product_name");
                row[1] = rs.getInt("total_sold");

                list.add(row);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting top selling products",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =========================
    // 7. ORDER STATUS
    // =========================
    public List<Object[]> getOrderStatusStatistics() {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT "
                + "o.order_status, "
                + "COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "GROUP BY o.order_status "
                + "ORDER BY total DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Object[] row = new Object[2];

                row[0] = rs.getString("order_status");
                row[1] = rs.getInt("total");

                list.add(row);
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting order status statistics",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Notification;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class NotificationDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(NotificationDAO.class.getName());

    // =========================
    // 1. CREATE ORDER STATUS NOTIFICATION
    // =========================
    public boolean createOrderStatusNotification(
            int orderId, String status) {

        String title = "Cap nhat don hang #" + orderId;
        String message = "Don hang #" + orderId
                + " da duoc cap nhat trang thai: " + status + ".";

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "(user_id, order_id, title, message) "
                + "SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, ?, ? "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, title);
            ps.setString(2, message);
            ps.setInt(3, orderId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error creating order status notification",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =========================
    // 2. COUNT UNREAD NOTIFICATIONS
    // =========================
    public int countUnread(int userId) {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND is_read = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt(1);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error counting unread notifications",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =========================
    // 3. GET LATEST NOTIFICATIONS
    // =========================
    public List<Notification> findLatest(int userId) {

        List<Notification> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT TOP 20 "
                + "notification_id, user_id, order_id, "
                + "title, message, is_read, created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {

                    Notification n = new Notification();

                    n.setNotificationId(
                            rs.getInt("notification_id"));

                    n.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));

                    int orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");

                    if (rs.wasNull()) {
                        n.setOrderId(null);
                    } else {
                        n.setOrderId(orderId);
                    }

                    n.setTitle(rs.getString("title"));
                    n.setMessage(rs.getString("message"));
                    n.setRead(rs.getBoolean("is_read"));
                    n.setCreatedAt(
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    list.add(n);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting latest notifications",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =========================
    // 4. MARK NOTIFICATION AS READ
    // =========================
    public boolean markAsRead(int notificationId, int userId) {

        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.NOTIFICATION "
                + "SET is_read = 1 "
                + "WHERE notification_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, notificationId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error marking notification as read",
                    ex
            );
        }

        return false;
    }

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import model.Order;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Collections;

public class OrderDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public OrderDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public OrderDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    // Servlet instances are shared across requests; never share a JDBC connection.
    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();
        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException("Khong ket noi duoc database.");
        }
        return conn;
    }

    public List<Order> findByUser(int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            return findByUser(conn, userId);
        }
    }

    private static final String PURCHASE_SEARCH = " FROM dbo.[ORDER] o WHERE o.user_id = ? "
            + "AND (? = N'' OR CONVERT(varchar(20), o.order_id) = ? OR EXISTS ("
            + "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM si JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ss ON ss.sku_id = si.sku_id "
            + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT sp ON sp.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE si.order_id = o.order_id "
            + "AND (sp.product_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' OR ss.sku_code LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'))) ";

    private int bindPurchaseSearch(PreparedStatement ps, int userId, String query) throws SQLException {
        String text = query == null ? "" : query.trim();
        String pattern = "%" + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%")
                .replace("_", "\\_").replace("[", "\\[") + "%";
        ps.setInt(1, userId);
        ps.setNString(2, text);
        ps.setString(3, text.startsWith("#") ? text.substring(1) : text);
        ps.setNString(4, pattern);
        ps.setNString(5, pattern);
        return 6;
    }

    public Map<String, Long> countPurchasesByStatus(int userId, String query) throws SQLException {
        Map<String, Long> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        String sql = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total" + PURCHASE_SEARCH + "GROUP BY o.order_status";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            bindPurchaseSearch(ps, userId, query);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    counts.put(rs.getString("order_status"), rs.getLong("total"));
                }
            }
        }
        return counts;
    }

    public List<Order> findPurchasePage(int userId, String query, List<String> statuses,
            long offset, int pageSize) throws SQLException {
        if (offset < 0 || pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 50) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid page");
        }
        String statusFilter = statuses.isEmpty() ? "" : "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) IN ("
                + String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(statuses.size(), "?")) + ") ";
        String sql = "SELECT o.*" + PURCHASE_SEARCH + statusFilter
                + "ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT ? ROWS ONLY";
        List<Order> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            int index = bindPurchaseSearch(ps, userId, query);
            for (String status : statuses) {
                ps.setString(index++, status);
            }
            ps.setLong(index++, offset);
            ps.setInt(index, pageSize);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    result.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    // One query for all visible cards; ownership is checked even for supplied IDs.
    public Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> findItemsForOrders(int userId, List<Integer> ids) throws SQLException {
        Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return result;
        }
        if (ids.size() > 50) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many orders");
        }
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, s.sku_code, p.product_name "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND o.order_id IN (" + String.join(",", Collections.nCopies(ids.size(), "?"))
                + ") ORDER BY i.order_id, i.order_item_id";
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 2, ids.get(i));
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    result.computeIfAbsent(rs.getInt("order_id"), key -> new ArrayList<>()).add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    // GIU HAM CU DE ORDERSERVICE HIEN TAI VAN GOI DUOC
    public int insert(Connection conn, Order order) throws SQLException {
        return insert(conn, order, null);
    }

    // TAO DON HANG CO TOKEN CHONG TRUNG
    public int insert(
            Connection conn,
            Order order,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "(user_id, address_id, total_amount, shipping_fee, "
                + "order_status, payment_method, payment_status, "
                + "recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_address, "
                + "discount_amount, checkout_token) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, order.getUserId());
            ps.setInt(2, order.getAddressId());
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, order.getTotalAmount());
            ps.setBigDecimal(4, order.getShippingFee());
            ps.setString(5, order.getOrderStatus());
            ps.setString(6, order.getPaymentMethod());
            ps.setString(7, order.getPaymentStatus());
            ps.setString(8, order.getRecipientName());
            ps.setString(9, order.getRecipientPhone());
            ps.setString(10, order.getShippingAddress());
            ps.setBigDecimal(11, order.getDiscountAmount());
            ps.setString(12, checkoutToken);

            ps.executeUpdate();

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Khong lay duoc ma don hang."
                    );
                }

                return rs.getInt(1);
            }
        }
    }

    // LUU CHI TIET DON HANG
    public void insertItem(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            int skuId,
            BigDecimal price,
            int quantity
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                + "(order_id, sku_id, price, quantity) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, price);
            ps.setInt(4, quantity);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    // LUU LICH SU TRANG THAI
    public void addHistory(
            Connection conn,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setString(2, status);

            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    // TIM DON DA TAO BANG TOKEN TRONG TRANSACTION
    public Integer findIdByToken(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT order_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND checkout_token = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setString(2, checkoutToken);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("order_id");
                }

                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    // TIM DON BANG TOKEN KHI GOI TU SERVLET
    public Integer findIdByToken(
            int userId,
            String checkoutToken
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            return findIdByToken(conn, userId, checkoutToken);
        }
    }

    // LAY DON THEO ID VA KIEM TRA CHU SO HUU
    public Order findByIdAndUser(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                ps.setInt(2, userId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return mapOrder(rs);
                    }

                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // LAY DANH SACH DON HANG CUA USER
    public List<Order> findByUser(
            Connection conn,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Order> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, order_id DESC";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    orders.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }

        return orders;
    }

    // CHUYEN RESULTSET THANH OBJECT ORDER
    private Order mapOrder(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Order order = new Order();

        order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
        order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));

        order.setShippingPartnerId(
                (Integer) rs.getObject("shipping_partner_id")
        );

        order.setTotalAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount"));
        order.setShippingFee(rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee"));
        order.setDiscountAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("discount_amount"));

        order.setOrderStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
        order.setPaymentMethod(rs.getString("payment_method"));
        order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));

        order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
        order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));

        order.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
        order.setPaymentExpiresAt(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "payment_expires_at",
                        java.util.Calendar.getInstance(
                                java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
                        )
                )
        );

        return order;
    }

    // Customer detail queries always include the authenticated owner.
    public List<Map<String, Object>> findItems(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_item_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, s.sku_code, p.product_name "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY i.order_item_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return items;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT h.status, h.updated_at FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY h.updated_at, h.status_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> history = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    entry.put("status", rs.getString("status"));
                    entry.put("updatedAt", rs.getTimestamp("updated_at"));
                    history.add(entry);
                }
            }
        }
        return history;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public class PaymentDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public PaymentDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public PaymentDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    // Moi thao tac dung connection rieng
    private Connection open() throws SQLException {
        Connection connection = connections.open();

        if (connection == null) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Không kết nối được database."
            );
        }

        return connection;
    }

    // Thong tin mot lan thanh toan
    public static final class Attempt {

        public final String ref;
        public final String method;
        public final String url;
        public final BigDecimal amount;
        public final long seconds;

        public Attempt(
                String ref,
                String method,
                String url,
                BigDecimal amount,
                long seconds
        ) {
            this.ref = ref;
            this.method = method;
            this.url = url;
            this.amount = amount;
            this.seconds = seconds;
        }
    }

    private static final class LockedOrder {

        int id;
        int owner;
        String status;
        String method;
        String payment;
        BigDecimal amount;
        long seconds;
        boolean restored;
    }

    // Khoa ORDER truoc khi thay doi thanh toan hoac ton kho
    private LockedOrder lock(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql =
                "SELECT *, "
                + "DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, SYSUTCDATETIME(), "
                + "payment_expires_at) AS seconds_left "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
