            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                LockedOrder order = new LockedOrder();

                order.id = orderId;
                order.owner = rs.getInt("user_id");
                order.status = rs.getString("order_status");
                order.method = rs.getString("payment_method");
                order.payment = rs.getString("payment_status");
                order.amount = rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount");
                order.seconds = rs.getLong("seconds_left");
                order.restored =
                        rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null;

                return order;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int update(
            Connection connection,
            String sql,
            Object... values
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                ps.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            }

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    private void history(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {

        update(
                connection,
                "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)",
                orderId,
                status
        );
    }

    private static void rollback(
            Connection connection,
            Exception original
    ) {
        try {
            connection.rollback();
        } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
            original.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
        }
    }

    // Chi huy tu dong don dang cho thanh toan da het han
    private boolean expire(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                || order.seconds > 0
                || "PAID".equals(order.payment)) {
            return false;
        }

        cancel(connection, order);
        return true;
    }

    // Ham noi bo: ORDER phai duoc khoa truoc khi goi
    private void cancel(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (!order.restored) {
            List<int[]> items = new ArrayList<>();

            String sql =
                    "SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty "
                    + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                    + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                    + "GROUP BY sku_id "
                    + "ORDER BY sku_id";

            try (PreparedStatement ps =
                    connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, order.id);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    while (rs.next()) {
                        items.add(new int[]{
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                            rs.getInt("qty")
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            if (items.isEmpty()) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Đơn hàng không có chi tiết."
                );
            }

            for (int[] item : items) {
                if (item[1] <= 0) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Số lượng sản phẩm không hợp lệ."
                    );
                }

                int affected = update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        item[1],
                        item[0]
                );

                if (affected != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không hoàn được tồn kho."
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', "
                + "payment_status = 'UNPAID', "
                + "stock_restored_at = COALESCE("
                + "stock_restored_at, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                order.id
        );

        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                + "SET status = 'EXPIRED' "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                order.id
        );

        // Giu luot voucher theo nghiep vu huy COD hien tai
        history(connection, order.id, "CANCELLED");

        order.status = "CANCELLED";
        order.restored = true;
    }

    // Bat dau thanh toan hoac mo lai link dang cho
    public Attempt begin(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn đã hết 15 phút thanh toán "
                            + "và được hủy."
                    );
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán."
                    );
                }

                PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(order.method);

                String sql =
                        "SELECT TOP 1 transaction_code, pay_url, "
                        + "DATEDIFF(SECOND, created_at, "
                        + "SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS age "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ? "
                        + "AND status = 'PENDING' "
                        + "ORDER BY transaction_id DESC";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setString(2, order.method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            String url = rs.getString("pay_url");

                            // Dung lai link de tranh tao nhieu giao dich
                            if (url != null) {
                                Attempt attempt = new Attempt(
                                        rs.getString("transaction_code"),
                                        order.method,
                                        url,
                                        order.amount,
                                        order.seconds
                                );

                                connection.commit();
                                return attempt;
                            }

                            if (rs.getInt("age") < 30) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Đang tạo thanh toán. "
                                        + "Chờ vài giây rồi thử lại."
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'EXPIRED' "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                        orderId
                );

                String ref = "OECS"
                        + orderId
                        + UUID.randomUUID()
                                .toString()
                                .replace("-", "");

                update(
                        connection,
                        "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "(order_id, payment_method, amount, "
                        + "transaction_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        orderId,
                        order.method,
                        order.amount,
                        ref
                );

                connection.commit();

                return new Attempt(
                        ref,
                        order.method,
                        null,
                        order.amount,
                        order.seconds
                );

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // Luu link do cong thanh toan tra ve
    public void saveUrl(
            String ref,
            String url
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            update(
                    connection,
                    "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                    + "SET pay_url = ? "
                    + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                    + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                    url,
                    ref
            );
        }
    }

    // toCod = true: doi COD; false: huy don dang cho
    public void changeOrCancel(
            int userId,
            int orderId,
            boolean toCod
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                // Gui lap thao tac doi COD
                if (toCod
                        && "COD".equals(order.method)
                        && "PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(order.status)) {

                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                // Gui lap thao tac huy
                if (!toCod && "CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán. "
                            + "Hãy tải lại trang."
                    );
                }

                if (toCod) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_method = 'COD', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL, "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_status = 'UNPAID' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    cancel(connection, order);
                }

                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // Chi goi sau khi servlet da xac minh chu ky va merchant
    public String settle(
            String method,
            String ref,
            BigDecimal amount,
            String providerId,
            String code,
            boolean success
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                int orderId;

                String sql =
                        "SELECT order_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            connection.rollback();
                            return "01";
                        }

                        orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");
                    }
                }

                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                long transactionId;
                String transactionStatus;
                BigDecimal expectedAmount;

                sql =
                        "SELECT transaction_id, status, amount "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không tìm thấy giao dịch."
                            );
                        }

                        transactionId = rs.getLong("transaction_id");
                        transactionStatus = rs.getString("status");
                        expectedAmount = rs.getBigDecimal("amount");
                    }
                }

                if (expectedAmount.compareTo(amount) != 0
                        || order.amount.compareTo(amount) != 0) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "04";
                }

                // Callback lap: khong xu ly thanh cong lan nua
                if ("SUCCESS".equals(transactionStatus)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return "02";
                }

                if (success
                        && (providerId == null
                        || providerId.isEmpty()
                        || "0".equals(providerId))) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "99";
                }

                // Kiem tra han ngay ca khi worker chua kip chay
                expire(connection, order);

                if (!success) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'FAILED', "
                            + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                            + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                            + "WHERE transaction_id = ? "
                            + "AND status <> 'SUCCESS'",
                            code,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    connection.commit();
                    return "00";
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'SUCCESS', "
                        + "provider_transaction_id = ?, "
                        + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                        + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                        + "WHERE transaction_id = ?",
                        providerId,
                        code,
                        transactionId
                );

                boolean canConfirm =
                        "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        && !"PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        && !order.restored
                        && method.equals(order.method)
                        && order.seconds > 0;

                if (canConfirm) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_status = 'PAID', "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND transaction_id <> ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    // Tien ve tre, doi COD hoac thanh toan trung
                    // Chi tao yeu cau hoan tien, khong hoi sinh don
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND "
                            + "(transaction_id, refund_amount, reason) "
                            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                            transactionId,
                            amount,
                            "Thanh toán về trễ, đổi COD hoặc "
                            + "thanh toán trùng; cần đối soát "
                            + "và hoàn tiền."
                    );

                    if ("CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                        update(
                                connection,
                                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                                + "SET payment_status = 'REFUND_PENDING' "
                                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                                orderId
                        );
                    }
                }

                connection.commit();
                return "00";

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // Kiem tra het han cua mot don
    public void expireOrder(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                expire(connection, order);
                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // Worker goi de quet cac don qua han
    public void expireBatch() throws SQLException {
        List<int[]> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql =
                "SELECT TOP 200 order_id, user_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' "
                + "AND payment_expires_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "ORDER BY order_id";

        try (
                Connection connection = open();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()
        ) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                orders.add(new int[]{
                    rs.getInt("order_id"),
                    rs.getInt("user_id")
                });
            }
        }

        for (int[] order : orders) {
            expireOrder(order[1], order[0]);
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Brand;
import model.Category;
import model.Product;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Product> getList() {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        // Đã bổ sung đầy đủ INNER JOIN theo chuẩn DB[cite: 1]
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.logo_url "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Category category = new Category(
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getString("category_name"),
                        rs.getObject("parent_id") != null ? rs.getInt("parent_id") : null
                );

                Brand brand = new Brand(
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("brand_name"),
                        rs.getString("logo_url")
                );

                Product product = new Product(
                        rs.getInt("product_id"),
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("product_name"),
                        rs.getString("description"),
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                        rs.getString("image_url"),
                        category,
                        brand
                );

                list.add(product);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy danh sách Product!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public int insert(Product product) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT (product_name, description, category_id, brand_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setString(1, product.getProductName());
            statement.setString(2, product.getDescription());
            statement.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            statement.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            statement.setString(5, product.getImageUrl()); // Lưu đường dẫn ảnh

            return statement.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int update(Product product) {
        // Nếu có upload ảnh mới thì cập nhật, nếu không thì giữ nguyên ảnh cũ bằng COALESCE
        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT SET product_name=?, description=?, category_id=?, brand_id=?, image_url=COALESCE(?, image_url) WHERE product_id=?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setString(1, product.getProductName());
            statement.setString(2, product.getDescription());
            statement.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            statement.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            statement.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());
            statement.setInt(6, product.getProductId());

            return statement.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int delete(int productId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, productId);
            return statement.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi xóa Product!", ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public Product getById(int id) {
        // Đã bổ sung đầy đủ INNER JOIN theo chuẩn DB[cite: 1]
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.logo_url "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getString("category_name"),
                            rs.getObject("parent_id") != null ? rs.getInt("parent_id") : null
                    );

                    Brand brand = new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    );

                    // Đã sửa lỗi logic: thêm return để trả về đối tượng tìm được[cite: 1]
                    return new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"),
                            rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                            rs.getString("image_url"),
                            category,
                            brand
                    );
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Product theo ID!", ex);
        }
        return null;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SEARCH PRODUCTS
    // =====================================================
    public List<Product> searchProducts(String keyword) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        // Đã bổ sung đầy đủ INNER JOIN và điều kiện WHERE để tìm kiếm tương đối[cite: 1]
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.logo_url "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_name LIKE ? OR c.category_name LIKE ? OR b.brand_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            // Thêm ký tự % để tìm kiếm chuỗi chứa từ khóa (Tương đối)
            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword + "%";
            statement.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(2, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(3, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getString("category_name"),
                            rs.getObject("parent_id") != null ? rs.getInt("parent_id") : null
                    );

                    Brand brand = new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    );

                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"),
                            rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                            rs.getString("image_url"),
                            category,
                            brand
                    );
                    list.add(product);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi tìm kiếm Product!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductReview;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ProductReviewDAO extends DBContext {

    // =====================================================
    // GET SKU ID BY ORDER ITEM
    // =====================================================
    public int getSkuIdByOrderItemId(int orderItemId) {

        String sql = "SELECT sku_id "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("sku_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CHECK CAN REVIEW
    // =====================================================
    public boolean canReview(
            int userId,
            int orderItemId,
            int skuId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND oi.sku_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                // ĐƠN HÀNG PHẢI HOÀN TẤT
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED') "
                // CHƯA ĐÁNH GIÁ SẢN PHẨM NÀY
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Lỗi kiểm tra quyền đánh giá",
                            e
                    );
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CHECK ALREADY REVIEWED
    // =====================================================
    public boolean alreadyReviewed(int orderItemId) {

        String sql = "SELECT review_id "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // INSERT REVIEW
    // =====================================================
    public int insertReview(ProductReview review) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "(user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, rating, comment, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());
            ps.setInt(2, review.getOrderItemId());
            ps.setInt(3, review.getSkuId());
            ps.setInt(4, review.getRating());
            ps.setString(5, review.getComment());

            int rows = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (rows > 0) {
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // INSERT REVIEW IMAGE
    // =====================================================
    public boolean insertReviewImage(int reviewId, String imageUrl) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO REVIEW_IMAGES (review_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
            ps.setString(2, imageUrl);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // GET REVIEW BY ID + USER
    // =====================================================
    public ProductReview getReviewByIdAndUserId(int reviewId, int userId) {

        String sql = "SELECT review_id, user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, "
                + "rating, comment, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    ProductReview review = mapReview(rs);
                    review.setImages(getReviewImages(reviewId));
                    return review;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return null;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // GET REVIEW IMAGES
    // =====================================================
    public List<String> getReviewImages(int reviewId) {

        List<String> images = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT image_url "
                + "FROM REVIEW_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, reviewId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    images.add(rs.getString("image_url"));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return images;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // UPDATE REVIEW
    // =====================================================
    public boolean updateReview(ProductReview review) {

        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "SET rating = ?, comment = ? "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, review.getRating());
            ps.setString(2, review.getComment());
            ps.setInt(3, review.getReviewId());
            ps.setInt(4, review.getUserId());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // DELETE REVIEW
    // =====================================================
    public boolean deleteReview(int reviewId, int userId) {

        String deleteImagesSql = "DELETE FROM REVIEW_IMAGES WHERE review_id = ?";
        String deleteReviewSql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE review_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        Connection conn = null;

        try {
            conn = getConnection();
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try (PreparedStatement psImages = conn.prepareStatement(deleteImagesSql)) {
                psImages.setInt(1, reviewId);
                psImages.executeUpdate();
            }

            int rows;
            try (PreparedStatement psReview = conn.prepareStatement(deleteReviewSql)) {
                psReview.setInt(1, reviewId);
                psReview.setInt(2, userId);

                rows = psReview.executeUpdate();
            }

            if (rows > 0) {
                conn.commit();
                return true;
            }

            conn.rollback();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            if (conn != null) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackException) {
                    rollbackException.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            e.printStackTrace();

        } finally {
            if (conn != null) {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                    conn.close();
                } catch (SQLException closeException) {
                    closeException.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // GET REVIEWS BY SKU
    // =====================================================
    public List<ProductReview> getReviewsBySkuId(int skuId) {

        List<ProductReview> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT review_id, user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, "
                + "rating, comment, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                + "AND is_hidden = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    ProductReview review = mapReview(rs);
                    review.setImages(getReviewImages(review.getReviewId()));
                    reviews.add(review);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return reviews;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // GET AVERAGE RATING
    // =====================================================
    public double getAverageRating(int skuId) {

        String sql = "SELECT AVG(CAST(rating AS FLOAT)) AS average_rating "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?"
                + "AND is_hidden = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getDouble("average_rating");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // COUNT REVIEWS
    // =====================================================
    public int countReviewsBySkuId(int skuId) {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?"
                + "AND is_hidden = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // MAP RESULTSET -> PRODUCT REVIEW
    // =====================================================
    private ProductReview mapReview(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {

        ProductReview review = new ProductReview();

        review.setReviewId(rs.getInt("review_id"));
        review.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        review.setOrderItemId(rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
        review.setSkuId(rs.getInt("sku_id"));
        review.setRating(rs.getInt("rating"));
        review.setComment(rs.getString("comment"));
        review.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

        return review;
    }

    public ProductReview getReviewByOrderItemIdAndUserId(
            int orderItemId,
            int userId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "ON oi.order_item_id = pr.order_item_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND pr.user_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ?";

        ProductReview review = null;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    review = mapReview(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể tải đánh giá sản phẩm", e
            );
        }

        if (review != null) {
            review.setImages(
                    getReviewImages(review.getReviewId())
            );
        }

        return review;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductSku;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductSkuDAO extends DBContext {

    // Lấy danh sách SKU theo Product ID
    public List<ProductSku> getByProductId(int productId) {
        List<ProductSku> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT sku_id, product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = ? ORDER BY sku_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductSku(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"),
                            rs.getDouble("price"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity")
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    // Thêm SKU mới
    public int insert(ProductSku sku) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SKU (product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, sku.getProductId());
            ps.setString(2, sku.getSkuCode());
            ps.setDouble(3, sku.getPrice());
            ps.setInt(4, sku.getStockQuantity());

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // Xóa SKU
    public int delete(int skuId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE sku_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            return ps.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ReportDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ReportDAO.class.getName());

    // Chỉ tính doanh thu từ đơn đã hoàn thành
    private static final String COMPLETED_CONDITION
            = " o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' ";

    // =====================================================
    // 1. TOTAL REVENUE
    // =====================================================
    public BigDecimal getTotalRevenueByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    BigDecimal result
                            = rs.getBigDecimal("total_revenue");

                    return result != null
                            ? result : BigDecimal.ZERO;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting total revenue", e);
        }

        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 2. COMPLETED ORDERS
    // =====================================================
    public int getCompletedOrdersByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total_orders");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting completed orders", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 3. TOTAL PRODUCTS SOLD
    // =====================================================
    public int getTotalProductsSoldByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_products "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total_products");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting products sold", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 4. REVENUE BY DATE
    // Object[]: [date, revenue, orderCount]
    // =====================================================
    public List<Object[]> getRevenueByDateRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS report_date, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue, "
                + "COUNT(*) AS order_count "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION
                + " GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY report_date DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getDate("report_date"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("revenue"),
                        rs.getInt("order_count")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting revenue by date", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 5. AVERAGE ORDER VALUE (AOV)
    // =====================================================
    public BigDecimal getAverageOrderValueByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        BigDecimal revenue
                = getTotalRevenueByRange(startDate, endDate);

        int orders
                = getCompletedOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate);

        if (orders == 0) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        return revenue.divide(
                BigDecimal.valueOf(orders),
                2,
                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
        );
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 6. ORDER STATUS STATISTICS
    // Object[]: [status, count]
    // =====================================================
    public List<Object[]> getOrderStatusByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "GROUP BY o.order_status "
                + "ORDER BY total DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getString("order_status"),
                        rs.getInt("total")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting order statuses", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 7. TOP 5 BEST SELLING PRODUCTS
    // Object[]: [productName, quantity]
    // =====================================================
    public List<Object[]> getTopSellingProductsByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP 5 "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON oi.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name "
                + "ORDER BY total_sold DESC, p.product_name ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {

                    Object[] row = new Object[2];

                    row[0] = rs.getString("product_name");
                    row[1] = rs.getInt("total_sold");

                    list.add(row);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting top selling products", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // HELPER: DATE RANGE
    // Bao gồm toàn bộ ngày kết thúc
    // =====================================================
    private void setDateRange(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            LocalDate startDate,
            LocalDate endDate) throws SQLException {

        ps.setDate(1, java.sql.Date.valueOf(startDate));

        ps.setDate(2,
                java.sql.Date.valueOf(endDate.plusDays(1)));
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class ReviewReportDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllReports()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> reports = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT rr.report_id, rr.review_id, "
                + "rr.reported_by, reporter.username AS reporter_name, "
                + "rr.reason, rr.report_status, rr.created_at, "
                + "rr.resolved_by, resolver.username AS resolver_name, "
                + "rr.resolved_at, "
                + "author.username AS review_author, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.is_hidden, "
                + "p.product_name, ps.sku_code "
                + "FROM REVIEW_REPORTS rr "
                + "JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "ON rr.review_id = pr.review_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN [USER] reporter "
                + "ON rr.reported_by = reporter.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN [USER] resolver "
                + "ON rr.resolved_by = resolver.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN [USER] author "
                + "ON pr.user_id = author.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY CASE WHEN rr.report_status = 'PENDING' "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rr.created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Map<String, Object> report = new HashMap<>();

                report.put("reportId", rs.getInt("report_id"));
                report.put("reviewId", rs.getInt("review_id"));
                report.put("reporterName", rs.getString("reporter_name"));
                report.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                report.put("status", rs.getString("report_status"));
                report.put("createdAt", rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                report.put("resolverName", rs.getString("resolver_name"));
                report.put("resolvedAt", rs.getTimestamp("resolved_at"));
                report.put("reviewAuthor", rs.getString("review_author"));
                report.put("rating", rs.getInt("rating"));
                report.put("comment", rs.getString("comment"));
                report.put("isHidden", rs.getBoolean("is_hidden"));
                report.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                report.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));

                reports.add(report);
            }
        }

        return reports;
    }

    public String createReport(int reviewId, int reportedBy, String reason)
            throws SQLException {

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            // Kiểm tra đánh giá có tồn tại không.
            Integer ownerId = null;

            String findReview = "SELECT user_id "
                    + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE review_id = ?";

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(findReview)) {
                ps.setInt(1, reviewId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        ownerId = rs.getInt("user_id");
                    }
                }
            }

            if (ownerId == null) {
                return "NOT_FOUND";
            }

            // Không cho khách hàng báo cáo đánh giá của chính mình.
            if (ownerId == reportedBy) {
                return "OWN_REVIEW";
            }

            // Không cho tạo nhiều báo cáo đang chờ trên cùng đánh giá.
            String checkPending = "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                    + "FROM REVIEW_REPORTS "
                    + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                    + "AND reported_by = ? "
                    + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(checkPending)) {
                ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                ps.setInt(2, reportedBy);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next() && rs.getInt(1) > 0) {
                        return "DUPLICATE";
                    }
                }
            }

            String insert = "INSERT INTO REVIEW_REPORTS "
                    + "(review_id, reported_by, reason, report_status, "
                    + "created_at) "
                    + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', GETDATE())";

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(insert)) {
                ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                ps.setInt(2, reportedBy);
                ps.setString(3, reason);

                return ps.executeUpdate() > 0 ? "SUCCESS" : "FAILED";

            } catch (SQLException e) {
                // SQL Server: 2601/2627 là lỗi trùng khóa duy nhất.
                if (e.getErrorCode() == 2601
                        || e.getErrorCode() == 2627) {
                    return "DUPLICATE";
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean resolveReport(int reportId, int staffId, String decision)
            throws SQLException {

        String newStatus;

        if ("HIDE".equals(decision)) {
            newStatus = "RESOLVED";
        } else if ("DISMISS".equals(decision)) {
            newStatus = "REJECTED";
        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Quyết định không hợp lệ.");
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                int reviewId;

                String findReport = "SELECT review_id "
                        + "FROM REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WHERE report_id = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(findReport)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        reviewId = rs.getInt("review_id");
                    }
                }

                // Chấp nhận báo cáo: ẩn đánh giá vi phạm.
                if ("HIDE".equals(decision)) {
                    String hideSql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                            + "SET is_hidden = 1 WHERE review_id = ?";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps =
                            conn.prepareStatement(hideSql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, reviewId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                String updateReport = "UPDATE REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "SET report_status = ?, resolved_by = ?, "
                        + "resolved_at = GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE report_id = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        conn.prepareStatement(updateReport)) {

                    ps.setString(1, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(2, staffId);
                    ps.setInt(3, reportId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Brand;
import model.Category;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductSku;
import model.ProductSpec;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ShopDAO extends DBContext {

    // Lấy danh sách sản phẩm kèm giá trị nhỏ nhất từ bảng SKU
    public List<Product> getCatalogProducts() {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        // ĐÃ THÊM p.image_url
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Category category = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                Product product = new Product(
                        rs.getInt("product_id"),
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("product_name"),
                        rs.getString("description"),
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                        category, brand
                );
                product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                product.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                list.add(product);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Catalog!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    // Lấy chi tiết 1 sản phẩm
    public Product getProductDetail(int id) {
        // ĐÃ THÊM p.image_url
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, id);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                    Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"), category, brand
                    );
                    product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    return product;
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi chi tiết SP!", ex);
        }
        return null;
    }

    // Lấy các biến thể (SKU) của sản phẩm
    public List<ProductSku> getProductSkus(int productId) {
        List<ProductSku> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT sku_id, product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = ? ORDER BY price ASC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductSku(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"), rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"), rs.getDouble("price"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity")
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy SKU!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    // Lấy thông số kỹ thuật của sản phẩm
    public List<ProductSpec> getProductSpecs(int productId) {
        List<ProductSpec> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT a.attribute_name, ps.value FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a ON ps.attribute_id = a.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductSpec(rs.getString("attribute_name"), rs.getString("value")));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Specs!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public List<Product> searchProducts(String keyword) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        // ĐÃ THÊM p.image_url
        String sql = "SELECT TOP 5 p.product_id, p.product_name, p.image_url, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_name LIKE ? OR p.description LIKE ? OR b.brand_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword + "%";
            statement.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(2, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(3, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Product p = new Product();
                    p.setProductId(rs.getInt("product_id"));
                    p.setProductName(rs.getString("product_name"));
                    p.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    p.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                    list.add(p);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi tìm kiếm sản phẩm!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    // Hàm tìm kiếm ĐẦY ĐỦ cho trang /shop (khi nhấn Enter tìm kiếm)
    public List<Product> searchFullCatalog(String keyword) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        // ĐÃ THÊM p.image_url
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_name LIKE ? OR c.category_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword + "%";
            statement.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(2, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                    Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"), category, brand
                    );
                    product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    product.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                    list.add(product);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi tìm kiếm danh mục/sản phẩm!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    // ==========================================
    // FILTER SẢN PHẨM (KATEGORIA, PRESIO, SORT)
    // ==========================================
    public List<Product> getFilteredCatalog(String keyword, String[] categoryIds, String priceRange, String sort) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        // ĐÃ THÊM p.image_url
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE 1=1 "
        );

        List<Object> parameters = new ArrayList<>();

        // 1. Filter theo Keyword
        if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sql.append("AND (p.product_name LIKE ? OR p.description LIKE ? OR c.category_name LIKE ? OR b.brand_name LIKE ?) ");
            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
        }

        // 2. Filter theo Danh mục
        if (categoryIds != null && categoryIds.length > 0) {
            sql.append("AND (");
            for (int i = 0; i < categoryIds.length; i++) {
                sql.append("c.category_id = ? OR c.parent_id = ?");
                parameters.add(Integer.parseInt(categoryIds[i]));
                parameters.add(Integer.parseInt(categoryIds[i]));
                if (i < categoryIds.length - 1) {
                    sql.append(" OR ");
                }
            }
            sql.append(") ");
        }

        // 3. Filter theo Mức giá
        if (priceRange != null) {
            if ("under5".equals(priceRange)) {
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) > 0 ");
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) < 5000000 ");
            } else if ("5to15".equals(priceRange)) {
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) BETWEEN 5000000 AND 15000000 ");
            } else if ("over15".equals(priceRange)) {
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) > 15000000 ");
            }
        }

        // 4. Sort (Sắp xếp)
        if ("priceAsc".equals(sort)) {
            sql.append("ORDER BY min_price ASC ");
        } else if ("priceDesc".equals(sort)) {
            sql.append("ORDER BY min_price DESC ");
        } else {
            sql.append("ORDER BY p.product_id DESC "); // Mặc định: Mới nhất
        }

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            // Truyền các dynamic parameters
            for (int i = 0; i < parameters.size(); i++) {
                if (parameters.get(i) instanceof String) {
                    ps.setNString(i + 1, (String) parameters.get(i));
                } else if (parameters.get(i) instanceof Integer) {
                    ps.setInt(i + 1, (Integer) parameters.get(i));
                }
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Category cat = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                    Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"), cat, brand
                    );
                    product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    product.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                    list.add(product);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi lọc sản phẩm!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }
}
