        return placeOrder(
                userId,
                addressId,
                checkoutToken,
                voucherCode,
                selectedCartItemIds,
                "COD"
        );
    }

    // Dat hang chung cho COD, VNPAY va MOMO
    public int placeOrder(
            int userId,
            int addressId,
            String checkoutToken,
            String voucherCode,
            List<Integer> selectedCartItemIds,
            String paymentMethod
    ) throws SQLException {

        PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(paymentMethod);

        if (userId <= 0
                || addressId <= 0
                || checkoutToken == null
                || !checkoutToken.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}")) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Yêu cầu đặt hàng không hợp lệ. "
                    + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
            );
        }

        // null chi dung cho ham tuong thich checkout toan bo gio
        boolean selectedMode = selectedCartItemIds != null;
        List<Integer> selectedIds = new ArrayList<>();

        if (selectedMode) {
            for (Integer id : selectedCartItemIds) {
                if (id != null
                        && id > 0
                        && !selectedIds.contains(id)) {
                    selectedIds.add(id);
                }
            }

            if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm để đặt hàng."
                );
            }
        }

        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không kết nối được database."
                );
            }

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                // 1. Khoa gio hang de chan dat trung dong thoi
                int cartId;

                String sql
                        = "SELECT cart_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.CART WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Giỏ hàng không tồn tại."
                            );
                        }

                        cartId = rs.getInt("cart_id");
                    }
                }

                // 2. Token da tao don thi tra ve don cu
                Integer existingOrderId = orderDAO.findIdByToken(
                        conn,
                        userId,
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (existingOrderId != null) {
                    conn.commit();
                    return existingOrderId;
                }

                // 3. Kiem tra dia chi va luu thong tin nguoi nhan
                Order order = new Order();
                order.setUserId(userId);
                order.setAddressId(addressId);

                sql
                        = "SELECT recipient_name, phone_number, address_line "
                        + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                        + "AND user_id = ? "
                        + "AND is_deleted = 0";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, addressId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                            );
                        }

                        order.setRecipientName(
                                rs.getString("recipient_name")
                        );
                        order.setRecipientPhone(
                                rs.getString("phone_number")
                        );
                        order.setShippingAddress(
                                rs.getString("address_line")
                        );
                    }
                }

                // 4. Lay dung cac san pham duoc chon
                List<CartLine> lines = new ArrayList<>();
                BigDecimal subtotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;

                StringBuilder itemsSql = new StringBuilder(
                        "SELECT ci.cart_item_id, ci.sku_id, "
                        + "ci.quantity, s.price "
                        + "FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS ci "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "ON s.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                        + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                );

                if (selectedMode) {
                    itemsSql.append("AND ci.cart_item_id IN (");

                    for (int i = 0; i < selectedIds.size(); i++) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            itemsSql.append(",");
                        }

                        itemsSql.append("?");
                    }

                    itemsSql.append(") ");
                }

                itemsSql.append("ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id");

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(itemsSql.toString())) {

                    int index = 1;
                    ps.setInt(index++, cartId);

                    if (selectedMode) {
                        for (Integer id : selectedIds) {
                            ps.setInt(index++, id);
                        }
                    }

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        while (rs.next()) {
                            int cartItemId = rs.getInt("cart_item_id");
                            int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");
                            int quantity = rs.getInt("quantity");
                            BigDecimal price = rs.getBigDecimal("price");

                            if (quantity <= 0
                                    || price == null
                                    || price.signum() < 0) {

                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Sản phẩm trong giỏ hàng "
                                        + "không hợp lệ."
                                );
                            }

                            lines.add(new CartLine(
                                    cartItemId,
                                    skuId,
                                    quantity,
                                    price
                            ));

                            subtotal = subtotal.add(
                                    price.multiply(
                                            BigDecimal.valueOf(quantity)
                                    )
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (lines.isEmpty()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            selectedMode
                                    ? "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm đã chọn."
                                    : "Giỏ hàng đang trống."
                    );
                }

                if (selectedMode && lines.size() != selectedIds.size()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Một số sản phẩm đã chọn "
                            + "không còn trong giỏ hàng."
                    );
                }

                // 5. Khoa va kiem tra voucher trong transaction
                VoucherResult voucher = lockAndCalculateVoucher(
                        conn,
                        userId,
                        voucherCode,
                        subtotal
                );

                // 6. Tinh tien tu du lieu database
                BigDecimal shippingFee = BigDecimal.ZERO;

                BigDecimal totalAmount = subtotal
                        .add(shippingFee)
                        .subtract(voucher.discount)
                        .max(BigDecimal.ZERO);

                // 7. Tru ton kho; don online giu hang bang cach nay
                sql
                        = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND stock_quantity >= ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (CartLine line : lines) {
                        ps.setInt(1, line.quantity);
                        ps.setInt(2, line.skuId);
                        ps.setInt(3, line.quantity);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Sản phẩm SKU " + line.skuId
                                    + " không đủ số lượng tồn kho."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 8. Tao don hang
                order.setShippingFee(shippingFee);
                order.setDiscountAmount(voucher.discount);
                order.setTotalAmount(totalAmount);
                order.setPaymentMethod(paymentMethod);

                boolean pendingPayment
                        = !"COD".equals(paymentMethod)
                        && totalAmount.signum() > 0;

                order.setOrderStatus(
                        pendingPayment
                                ? "PENDING_PAYMENT"
                                : "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                );

                order.setPaymentStatus(
                        totalAmount.signum() == 0
                        ? "PAID"
                        : "UNPAID"
                );

                int orderId = orderDAO.insert(
                        conn,
                        order,
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (orderId <= 0) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không thể tạo đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                // Han thanh toan online: 15 phut, luu UTC
                if (pendingPayment) {
                    sql
                            = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_expires_at = "
                            + "DATEADD(MINUTE, 15, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không lưu được hạn thanh toán."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 9. Luu gia va so luong tai thoi diem dat
                for (CartLine line : lines) {
                    orderDAO.insertItem(
                            conn,
                            orderId,
                            line.skuId,
                            line.price,
                            line.quantity
                    );
                }

                // 10. Luu lich su trang thai ban dau
                orderDAO.addHistory(
                        conn,
                        orderId,
                        order.getOrderStatus()
                );

                // 11. Ghi nhan luot su dung voucher
                if (voucher.id != null) {
                    sql
                            = "INSERT INTO dbo.VOUCHER_USAGES "
                            + "(voucher_id, order_id, user_id) "
                            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, voucher.id);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderId);
                        ps.setInt(3, userId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không lưu được lượt sử dụng voucher."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 12. Chi xoa cac san pham vua dat khoi gio
                sql
                        = "DELETE FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS "
                        + "WHERE cart_id = ? AND cart_item_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (CartLine line : lines) {
                        ps.setInt(1, cartId);
                        ps.setInt(2, line.cartItemId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không xóa được sản phẩm "
                                    + "đã đặt khỏi giỏ hàng."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 13. Hoan tat toan bo transaction
                conn.commit();
                return orderId;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // Kiem tra dieu kien, gioi han luot dung va tinh giam gia
    private VoucherResult lockAndCalculateVoucher(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            String voucherCode,
            BigDecimal subtotal
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (voucherCode == null || voucherCode.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new VoucherResult(null, BigDecimal.ZERO);
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT voucher_id, discount_type, discount_value, "
                + "max_discount, usage_limit, per_user_limit "
                + "FROM dbo.VOUCHER WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(?) "
                + "AND GETDATE() BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to "
                + "AND min_order_value <= ?";

        int voucherId;
        String discountType;
        BigDecimal discountValue;
        BigDecimal maxDiscount;
        Integer usageLimit;
        Integer perUserLimit;

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, voucherCode.trim());
            ps.setBigDecimal(2, subtotal);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Voucher hết hạn hoặc đơn hàng "
                            + "chưa đủ điều kiện áp dụng."
                    );
                }

                voucherId = rs.getInt("voucher_id");
                discountType = rs.getString("discount_type");
                discountValue = rs.getBigDecimal("discount_value");
                maxDiscount = rs.getBigDecimal("max_discount");

                Object usageValue = rs.getObject("usage_limit");

                usageLimit = usageValue == null
                        ? null
                        : ((Number) usageValue).intValue();

                Object perUserValue = rs.getObject("per_user_limit");

                perUserLimit = perUserValue == null
                        ? null
                        : ((Number) perUserValue).intValue();
            }
        }

        if (discountValue == null || discountValue.signum() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Voucher có giá trị giảm không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        // Dem luot su dung khi van dang giu khoa voucher
        sql
                = "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_used, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_id = ? "
                + "THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS user_used "
                + "FROM dbo.VOUCHER_USAGES "
                + "WHERE voucher_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, voucherId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                rs.next();

                long totalUsed = rs.getLong("total_used");
                long userUsed = rs.getLong("user_used");

                if (usageLimit != null && totalUsed >= usageLimit) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Voucher đã hết lượt sử dụng."
                    );
                }

                if (perUserLimit != null && userUsed >= perUserLimit) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Bạn đã dùng hết lượt của voucher này."
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        BigDecimal discount;

        if ("AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            discount = discountValue;

        } else if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            discount = subtotal
                    .multiply(discountValue)
                    .divide(
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(100),
                            2,
                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                    );

            if (maxDiscount != null) {
                discount = discount.min(maxDiscount);
            }

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Loại voucher không được hỗ trợ."
            );
        }

        discount = discount
                .max(BigDecimal.ZERO)
                .min(subtotal)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        return new VoucherResult(voucherId, discount);
    }

    // Huy COD theo luong cu; don online dang cho do PaymentDAO xu ly
    public boolean cancelOrderByCustomer(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (userId <= 0 || orderId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không kết nối được database."
                );
            }

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                String sql
                        = "SELECT order_status, payment_method, "
                        + "payment_status, total_amount, stock_restored_at "
                        + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                            );
                        }

                        String status = normalizeStatus(
                                rs.getString("order_status")
                        );

                        if ("CANCELLED".equals(status)) {
                            conn.commit();
                            return false;
                        }

                        if (!"PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(status)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Chỉ được hủy đơn trước khi "
                                    + "nhân viên xác nhận."
                            );
                        }

                        boolean isCod = "COD".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                rs.getString("payment_method")
                        );

                        boolean paidPositiveAmount
                                = "PAID".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                        rs.getString("payment_status")
                                )
                                && rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount")
                                        .signum() > 0;

                        if (!isCod || paidPositiveAmount) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Đơn này cần được hỗ trợ "
                                    + "xử lý thanh toán trước khi hủy."
                            );
                        }

                        if (rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Đơn đã được hoàn kho. "
                                    + "Vui lòng liên hệ hỗ trợ."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Gom cac dong cung SKU va hoan kho theo thu tu
                List<int[]> quantities = new ArrayList<>();

                sql
                        = "SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity "
                        + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                        + "GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY sku_id";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        while (rs.next()) {
                            int quantity = rs.getInt("quantity");

                            if (quantity <= 0) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Số lượng đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
                                );
                            }

                            quantities.add(new int[]{
                                rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                                quantity
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (quantities.isEmpty()) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Đơn hàng không có chi tiết để hoàn kho."
                    );
                }

                sql
                        = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (int[] item : quantities) {
                        ps.setInt(1, item[1]);
                        ps.setInt(2, item[0]);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không hoàn được tồn kho."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                sql
                        = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                        + "SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', "
                        + "stock_restored_at = GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                        + "AND stock_restored_at IS NULL "
                        + "AND UPPER(order_status) "
                        + "IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'PENDING')";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException(
                                "Trạng thái đơn hàng đã thay đổi."
                        );
                    }
                }

                orderDAO.addHistory(conn, orderId, "CANCELLED");

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    // Lay lich su kem nhan hien thi
    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> history
                = orderDAO.findHistory(orderId, userId);

        for (Map<String, Object> entry : history) {
            entry.put(
                    "label",
                    statusLabel((String) entry.get("status"))
            );
        }

        return history;
    }

    // Chuan hoa trang thai cu va moi
    public static String normalizeStatus(String status) {
        if (status == null) {
            return "";
        }

        String value = status
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replace(' ', '_');

        return "PENDING".equals(value)
                ? "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                : value;
    }

    public static Map<String, String> statusLabels() {
        Map<String, String> labels = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        labels.put("PENDING_PAYMENT", "Chờ thanh toán");
        labels.put("PENDING_CONFIRMATION", "Chờ xác nhận");
        labels.put("CONFIRMED", "Đã xác nhận");
        labels.put("PACKING", "Đang đóng gói");
        labels.put("SHIPPING", "Đang giao hàng");
        labels.put("DELIVERED", "Đã giao hàng");
        labels.put("COMPLETED", "Hoàn tất");
        labels.put("CANCELLED", "Đã hủy");

        return labels;
    }

    public static String statusLabel(String status) {
        return statusLabels().getOrDefault(
                normalizeStatus(status),
                status
        );
    }

    // Cac tab tren trang Don mua
    public static Map<String, String> purchaseTabs() {
        Map<String, String> tabs = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        tabs.put("ALL", "Tất cả");
        tabs.put("PAYMENT", "Chờ thanh toán");
        tabs.put("PENDING", "Chờ xác nhận");
        tabs.put("PREPARING", "Đang chuẩn bị hàng");
        tabs.put("SHIPPING", "Đang giao");
        tabs.put("COMPLETED", "Hoàn thành");
        tabs.put("CANCELLED", "Đã hủy");

        return tabs;
    }

    public static List<String> statusesForTab(String tab) {
        switch (tab) {
            case "PAYMENT":
                return Collections.singletonList("PENDING_PAYMENT");

            case "PENDING":
                return Arrays.asList(
                        "PENDING",
                        "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                );

            case "PREPARING":
                return Arrays.asList("CONFIRMED", "PACKING");

            case "SHIPPING":
                return Collections.singletonList("SHIPPING");

            case "COMPLETED":
                return Arrays.asList("DELIVERED", "COMPLETED");

            case "CANCELLED":
                return Collections.singletonList("CANCELLED");

            default:
                return Collections.emptyList();
        }
    }

    // Dem so don theo tung tab
    public static Map<String, Long> purchaseTabCounts(
            Map<String, Long> statuses
    ) {
        Map<String, Long> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String tab : purchaseTabs().keySet()) {
            counts.put(tab, 0L);
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : statuses.entrySet()) {
            counts.put(
                    "ALL",
                    counts.get("ALL") + entry.getValue()
            );

            for (String tab : purchaseTabs().keySet()) {
                if (statusesForTab(tab).contains(
                        normalizeStatus(entry.getKey())
                )) {
                    counts.put(
                            tab,
                            counts.get(tab) + entry.getValue()
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return counts;
    }

    // Tao cac buoc theo doi giao hang
    public static List<Map<String, Object>> trackingSteps(
            Order order,
            List<Map<String, Object>> history
    ) {
        List<String> states = Arrays.asList(
                "PENDING_CONFIRMATION",
                "CONFIRMED",
                "PACKING",
                "SHIPPING",
                "COMPLETED"
        );

        String status = normalizeStatus(order.getOrderStatus());

        int current = states.indexOf(
                "DELIVERED".equals(status)
                ? "COMPLETED"
                : status
        );

        // Don huy hoac cho thanh toan khong hien nhu da giao
        if (current < 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        String[] labels = {
            "Đã đặt hàng",
            "Đã xác nhận",
            "Đang chuẩn bị",
            "Đang giao hàng",
            "Giao thành công"
        };

        String[] icons = {
            "receipt",
            "check2-circle",
            "box-seam",
            "truck",
            "house-check"
        };

        List<Map<String, Object>> steps = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < states.size(); i++) {
            Map<String, Object> step = new LinkedHashMap<>();

            step.put("label", labels[i]);
            step.put("icon", icons[i]);
            step.put("done", i <= current);
            step.put("current", i == current);

            Object timestamp = i == 0
                    ? order.getCreatedAt()
                    : null;

            for (Map<String, Object> entry : history) {
                String recorded = normalizeStatus(
                        (String) entry.get("status")
                );

                if (states.get(i).equals(recorded)
                        || (i == 4 && "DELIVERED".equals(recorded))) {
                    timestamp = entry.get("updatedAt");
                }
            }

            step.put(
                    "at",
                    i <= current ? timestamp : null
            );

            steps.add(step);
        }

        return steps;
    }
}
package service;

import dao.PasswordResetDAO;
import dao.UserDAO;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.util.Base64;
import model.PasswordResetToken;
import model.User;

public class PasswordResetService {

    private final UserDAO userDAO = new UserDAO();
    private final PasswordResetDAO passwordResetDAO = new PasswordResetDAO();

    private static final long TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 15;

    // =====================================================
    // 1. TẠO TOKEN RESET PASSWORD
    // =====================================================
    public String createResetToken(String email) throws Exception {

        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        User user = userDAO.findByEmail(email.trim());

        if (user == null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Hủy các token cũ chưa sử dụng
        passwordResetDAO.invalidateOldTokens(user.getUserId());

        // Token thật gửi cho người dùng
        String rawToken = generateToken();

        // DB chỉ lưu hash của token
        String tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);

        long expireTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
                + TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

        Timestamp expiresAt = new Timestamp(expireTime);

        PasswordResetToken resetToken = new PasswordResetToken(
                user.getUserId(),
                tokenHash,
                expiresAt
        );

        boolean created = passwordResetDAO.createToken(resetToken);

        if (!created) {
            return null;
        }

        return rawToken;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 2. KIỂM TRA TOKEN
    // =====================================================
    public PasswordResetToken validateToken(String rawToken)
            throws Exception {

        if (rawToken == null || rawToken.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        String tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);

        return passwordResetDAO.findValidToken(tokenHash);
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 3. RESET PASSWORD
    // =====================================================
    public boolean resetPassword(String rawToken, String newPassword)
            throws Exception {

        if (rawToken == null || rawToken.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (newPassword == null || newPassword.length() < 6) {
            return false;
        }

        // Kiểm tra token
        PasswordResetToken token = validateToken(rawToken);

        if (token == null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Đổi mật khẩu
        boolean passwordUpdated = userDAO.resetPassword(
                token.getUserId(),
                newPassword
        );

        if (!passwordUpdated) {
            return false;
        }

        // Token chỉ được dùng 1 lần
        return passwordResetDAO.markAsUsed(token.getResetId());
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 4. TẠO TOKEN NGẪU NHIÊN
    // =====================================================
    private String generateToken() {

        SecureRandom secureRandom = new SecureRandom();

        byte[] bytes = new byte[32];

        secureRandom.nextBytes(bytes);

        return Base64.getUrlEncoder()
                .withoutPadding()
                .encodeToString(bytes);
    }

    // =====================================================
    // 5. HASH TOKEN BẰNG SHA-256
    // =====================================================
    private String hashToken(String rawToken)
            throws Exception {

        MessageDigest digest =
                MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");

        byte[] hash = digest.digest(
                rawToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        );

        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        for (byte b : hash) {
            result.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        }

        return result.toString();
    }
}

-- ========================================================
-- II. TẠO BẢNG (SCHEMA DEFINITIONS)
-- ========================================================

-- 1. QUẢN LÝ NGƯỜI DÙNG & PHÂN QUYỀN
CREATE TABLE ROLES (
    role_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    role_name NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description NVARCHAR(MAX)
);

CREATE TABLE [USER] (
    user_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_USER_IsActive DEFAULT (1)
);

CREATE TABLE USER_ROLES (
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    role_id INT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_UserRoles_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_UserRoles_Role FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES ROLES(role_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE STAFF (
    staff_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    department NVARCHAR(100),
    position NVARCHAR(100),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Staff_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE ADDRESSBOOK (
    address_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    recipient_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    address_line NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
    is_default BIT DEFAULT 0,
    -- >>> [BAT DAU PHAN TAM BO SUNG 4/4] SOFT DELETE ADDRESSBOOK
    is_deleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ADDRESSBOOK_is_deleted DEFAULT (0),
    -- <<< [KET THUC PHAN TAM BO SUNG 4/4]
    CONSTRAINT FK_AddressBook_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 2. DANH MỤC, SẢN PHẨM & THUỘC TÍNH
CREATE TABLE CATEGORY (
    category_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    parent_id INT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Category_Parent FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES CATEGORY(category_id)
);

CREATE TABLE BRAND (
    brand_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    brand_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    logo_url VARCHAR(2048)
);

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    product_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    category_id INT NOT NULL,
    brand_id INT NOT NULL,
    product_name NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description NVARCHAR(MAX),
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Product_Category FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES CATEGORY(category_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Product_Brand FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES BRAND(brand_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ATTRIBUTE (
    attribute_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    attribute_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION (
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    attribute_id INT NOT NULL,
    value NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, attribute_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Spec_Product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES PRODUCT(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Spec_Attribute FOREIGN KEY (attribute_id) REFERENCES ATTRIBUTE(attribute_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT_SKU (
    sku_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    sku_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    price DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL,
    stock_quantity INT DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_SKU_Product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES PRODUCT(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 3. GIỎ HÀNG
CREATE TABLE CART (
    cart_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Cart_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE CART_ITEMS (
    cart_item_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    cart_id INT NOT NULL,
    sku_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CartItems_Cart FOREIGN KEY (cart_id) REFERENCES CART(cart_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CartItems_SKU FOREIGN KEY (sku_id) REFERENCES PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 4. ĐƠN HÀNG, VẬN CHUYỂN & VOUCHER
CREATE TABLE SHIPPING_PARTNER (
    partner_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    partner_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(20)
);

CREATE TABLE VOUCHER (
    voucher_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    min_order_value DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Voucher_MinOrder DEFAULT 0,
    valid_from DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    valid_to DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    discount_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    discount_value DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    max_discount DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    usage_limit INT NULL,
    per_user_limit INT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_DiscountType CHECK (discount_type IN ('AMOUNT', 'PERCENT')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_DiscountValue CHECK (discount_value > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MinOrder CHECK (min_order_value >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_ValidDate CHECK (valid_to > valid_from),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MaxDiscount CHECK (max_discount IS NULL OR max_discount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_UsageLimit CHECK (usage_limit IS NULL OR usage_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_PerUserLimit CHECK (per_user_limit IS NULL OR per_user_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_PerUserVsTotal CHECK (usage_limit IS NULL OR per_user_limit IS NULL OR per_user_limit <= usage_limit),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MaxDiscountType CHECK (discount_type = 'PERCENT' OR max_discount IS NULL)
);

CREATE TABLE [ORDER] (
    order_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    address_id INT NOT NULL,
    shipping_partner_id INT,
    total_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    shipping_fee DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    -- >>> [BAT DAU PHAN TAM BO SUNG 1/4]
    order_status VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    payment_status VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    payment_expires_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    recipient_name NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    recipient_phone VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    shipping_address NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
    discount_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    stock_restored_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    -- <<< [KET THUC PHAN TAM BO SUNG 1/4]

    -- >>> [BAT DAU PHAN TAM BO SUNG: CHONG TRUNG ORDER]
    checkout_token VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    -- <<< [KET THUC PHAN TAM BO SUNG: CHONG TRUNG ORDER]
    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_Address FOREIGN KEY (address_id) REFERENCES ADDRESSBOOK(address_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_ShippingPartner FOREIGN KEY (shipping_partner_id) REFERENCES SHIPPING_PARTNER(partner_id)
);

-- =========================================
-- 8. NOTIFICATION - QUAN LY THONG BAO
-- =========================================
CREATE TABLE NOTIFICATION (
    notification_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

    -- Nguoi nhan thong bao
    user_id INT NOT NULL,

    -- Don hang lien quan (co the NULL neu la thong bao he thong)
    order_id INT NULL,

    -- Tieu de va noi dung thong bao
    title NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    message NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,

    -- Trang thai da doc hay chua
    is_read BIT NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_Notification_IsRead DEFAULT (0),

    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_Notification_CreatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()),

    -- Khoa ngoai
    CONSTRAINT FK_Notification_User
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT FK_Notification_Order
        FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL
);
GO

-- Tang toc do lay thong bao cua tung nguoi dung
CREATE INDEX IX_Notification_User_CreatedAt
ON NOTIFICATION(user_id, created_at DESC);

-- Tang toc do dem thong bao chua doc
CREATE INDEX IX_Notification_User_Unread
ON NOTIFICATION(user_id, is_read)
WHERE is_read = 0;
GO

CREATE TABLE ORDER_ITEM (
    order_item_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    sku_id INT NOT NULL,
    price DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItem_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_OrderItem_SKU FOREIGN KEY (sku_id) REFERENCES PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY (
    status_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    status NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_StatusHistory_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE VOUCHER_USAGES (
    usage_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    voucher_id INT NOT NULL,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    used_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_VoucherUsage_Voucher FOREIGN KEY (voucher_id) REFERENCES VOUCHER(voucher_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_VoucherUsage_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_VoucherUsage_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE COD_SETTLEMENTS (
    settlement_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    partner_id INT NOT NULL,
    total_cod_amount DECIMAL(18, 2) NOT NULL,
    settlement_date DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT FK_CODSettlement_Partner FOREIGN KEY (partner_id) REFERENCES SHIPPING_PARTNER(partner_id)
);

    CONSTRAINT FK_Review_OrderItem FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id) REFERENCES ORDER_ITEM(order_item_id),

);

-- >>> [BAT DAU PHAN TAM BO SUNG 2/4]
-- 7. PAYMENT GATEWAY (VNPAY / MOMO)
CREATE TABLE PAYMENT_TRANSACTION (
    transaction_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) CONSTRAINT PK_PAYMENT_TRANSACTION PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    transaction_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    provider_transaction_id VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentTransaction_Status DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    provider_response_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentTransaction_Created DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    completed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    -- [BO SUNG THANH TOAN] Luu link de mo lai cong thanh toan
    pay_url NVARCHAR(2048) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_PaymentTransaction_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_PaymentTransaction_Code UNIQUE (transaction_code),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Method CHECK (payment_method IN ('VNPAY','MOMO')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Amount CHECK (amount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED'))
);

CREATE TABLE PAYMENT_REFUND (
    refund_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) CONSTRAINT PK_PAYMENT_REFUND PRIMARY KEY,
    transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    refund_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    refund_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentRefund_Status DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    provider_refund_id VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    requested_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentRefund_Requested DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    completed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_PaymentRefund_Transaction FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES PAYMENT_TRANSACTION(transaction_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentRefund_Amount CHECK (refund_amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentRefund_Status CHECK (refund_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','SUCCESS','FAILED'))
);

-- [BO SUNG THANH TOAN] Chan trung giao dich thanh cong va yeu cau hoan tien
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Payment_Provider_Success
ON PAYMENT_TRANSACTION (payment_method, provider_transaction_id)
WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
  AND provider_transaction_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Payment_Refund_Transaction
ON PAYMENT_REFUND (transaction_id);

    CONSTRAINT FK_PasswordReset_User
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)

        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

    log_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

    actor_user_id INT NULL,
    actor_identifier VARCHAR(150) NULL,

    action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT NULL,

    description NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    ip_address VARCHAR(45) NULL,

    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_AuditLog_CreatedAt DEFAULT GETDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT FK_AuditLog_Actor
        FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL
);

-- >>> [BAT DAU PHAN TAM BO SUNG 3/4] 
-- BO SUNG DU LIEU CHO DON HANG MAU
UPDATE o SET recipient_name=a.recipient_name,
             recipient_phone=a.phone_number,
             shipping_address=a.address_line,
             payment_status='UNKNOWN'
FROM dbo.[ORDER] o
JOIN dbo.ADDRESSBOOK a ON a.address_id=o.address_id;

;WITH latest AS (
    SELECT order_id, status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC,status_id DESC) rn
    FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY
)
UPDATE o SET order_status=CASE UPPER(l.status)
   WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
   WHEN 'SHIPPING' THEN 'SHIPPING'
   WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED'
   WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'CONFIRMED'
   WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED'
   ELSE 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' END
FROM dbo.[ORDER] o
JOIN latest l ON l.order_id=o.order_id AND l.rn=1;
-- <<< [KET THUC PHAN TAM BO SUNG 3/4]
GO

    (N'Samsung Galaxy Watch7', 'WATCH-GW7-44', 6990000.00, 15),
    (N'Garmin Forerunner 165', 'WATCH-GARMIN-165', 6490000.00, 12),

    (N'Sony WH-1000XM5', 'SONY-WH1000XM5', 6990000.00, 15),
    (N'JBL Tune 770NC', 'JBL-T770NC', 2490000.00, 25),
    (N'Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro', 'SS-BUDS3-PRO', 4990000.00, 20),

    (N'Canon EOS R50', 'CAM-CANON-R50', 18990000.00, 8),
    (N'Sony Alpha A6400', 'CAM-SONY-A6400', 16990000.00, 6),
    (N'Fujifilm X-S20', 'CAM-FUJI-XS20', 28990000.00, 5)
) v(product_name, sku_code, price, stock_quantity)
JOIN PRODUCT p
    ON p.product_name = v.product_name

    SELECT 1

-- =====================================================
-- 1. THEM COT AN / HIEN DANH GIA
-- =====================================================

IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS', 'is_hidden') IS NULL
BEGIN
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS
    ADD is_hidden BIT NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PRODUCT_REVIEWS_is_hidden
        DEFAULT (0) WITH VALUES;
END;
GO

-- =====================================================
-- 2. TAO BANG LUU HINH ANH DANH GIA
-- =====================================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.REVIEW_IMAGES (
        image_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        review_id INT NOT NULL,
        image_url NVARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,

        CONSTRAINT FK_ReviewImages_Review
            FOREIGN KEY (review_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS(review_id)
            ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
END;
GO

-- =====================================================
-- 3. TAO BANG BAO CAO DANH GIA
-- =====================================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS (
        report_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        review_id INT NOT NULL,
        reported_by INT NOT NULL,
        reason NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,

        report_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_REVIEW_REPORTS_status
            DEFAULT ('PENDING'),

        created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_REVIEW_REPORTS_created_at
            DEFAULT (GETDATE()),

        resolved_by INT NULL,
        resolved_at DATETIME2 NULL,

        CONSTRAINT CK_REVIEW_REPORTS_status
            CHECK (
                report_status IN (
                    'PENDING', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED'
                )
            ),

        CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_review
            FOREIGN KEY (review_id)
            REFERENCES dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS(review_id),

        CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_reporter
            FOREIGN KEY (reported_by)
            REFERENCES dbo.[USER](user_id),

        CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_resolver
            FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by)
            REFERENCES dbo.[USER](user_id)
    );
END;
GO

-- =====================================================
-- 4. THEM INDEX CHO BAO CAO DANH GIA
-- =====================================================

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE name = 'IX_REVIEW_REPORTS_status_created'
      AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS')
)
BEGIN
    CREATE INDEX IX_REVIEW_REPORTS_status_created
    ON dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS(report_status, created_at DESC);
END;
GO

-- Moi nguoi dung chi co toi da 1 bao cao
-- dang cho xu ly cho moi danh gia
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE name = 'UX_REVIEW_REPORTS_one_pending_per_user'
      AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS')
)
BEGIN
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_REVIEW_REPORTS_one_pending_per_user
    ON dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS(review_id, reported_by)
    WHERE report_status = 'PENDING';
END;
GO

-- =====================================================
-- 5. THEM INDEX CHO DANH GIA AN / HIEN
-- =====================================================

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE name = 'IX_PRODUCT_REVIEWS_sku_hidden_created'
      AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS')
)
BEGIN
    CREATE INDEX IX_PRODUCT_REVIEWS_sku_hidden_created
    ON dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS(
        sku_id, is_hidden, created_at DESC
    );
END;
GO

-- =====================================================
-- 6. KIEM TRA KET QUA
-- =====================================================

SELECT
    TABLE_NAME,
    COLUMN_NAME,
    DATA_TYPE,
    IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN (
    'PRODUCT_REVIEWS',
    'REVIEW_IMAGES',
    'REVIEW_REPORTS'
)
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;

SELECT
    name AS index_name,
    OBJECT_NAME(object_id) AS table_name
FROM sys.indexes
WHERE name IN (
    'IX_REVIEW_REPORTS_status_created',
    'UX_REVIEW_REPORTS_one_pending_per_user',
    'IX_PRODUCT_REVIEWS_sku_hidden_created'
)
ORDER BY table_name, index_name;
GO
USE OECS;
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.BANNER', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.BANNER (
        banner_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        image_url NVARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
        alt_text NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
        target_url NVARCHAR(2048) NULL,
        is_active BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSDATETIME()
    );
END;
GO
